text: Campaign Mode only. Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add this card to your hand. Forced - When the game ends or you are eliminated, if this card is in your hand: You earn 2 fewer experience. [action]: Evade. Use only on an exhausted unengaged enemy at your location. If you succeed, discard this card from your hand.
real_text: Campaign Mode only. Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add this card to your hand. Forced - When the game ends or you are eliminated, if this card is in your hand: You earn 2 fewer experience. [action]: Evade. Use only on an exhausted unengaged enemy at your location. If you succeed, discard this card from your hand.

name: Przed Czarnym Tronem
text: Łatwy / Standardowy [skull]: -X. X wynosi połowę liczby żetonów zagłady na Azathocie (zaokrąglając w górę), do minimum 2. [cultist]: Odkryj nowy żeton. Jeśli test zakończy się porażką, przeszukaj talię spotkań i stos odrzuconych kart spotkań w poszukiwaniu wroga z cechą [[Kultysta]] i dobierz go. Potasuj talię spotkań. [tablet]: -2. Jeśli test zakończy się porażką, Azathoth atakuje cię. [elder_thing]: -4. Jeśli twoja zmodyfikowana wartość umiejętności do tego testu wynosi 0, umieść 1 żeton zagłady na Azathocie.
real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half of the doom on Azathoth (rounded up), to a minimum of 2.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Cultist]] enemy and draw it. Shuffle the encounter deck.
[tablet]: -2. If you fail, Azathoth attacks you.
[elder_thing]: -4. If your modified skill value for this test is 0, place 1 doom on Azathoth.
back_text: Trudny / Ekspercki [skull]: -X. X to liczba żetonów zagłady na Azathocie, minimum 2. [cultist]: Odkryj nowy żeton. Jeśli test zakończy się porażką, przeszukaj talię spotkań i stos odrzuconych kart spotkań w poszukiwaniu wroga z cechą [[Kultysta]] i dobierz go. Potasuj talię spotkań. [tablet]: -3. Jeśli test zakończy się porażką, Azathoth atakuje cię. [elder_thing]: -6. Jeśli twoja zmodyfikowana wartość umiejętności do tego testu wynosi 0, umieść 1 żeton zagłady na Azathocie.

name: WHEEL OF FORTUNE · X
text:
Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it.
Do not remove doom from enemies when this agenda advances.
real_text:
Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it.
Do not remove doom from enemies when this agenda advances.
flavor:
ONE END IS ANOTHER BEGINNING.
CHANGE IS THE ONLY CONSTANT.
YOUR ULTIMATE FATE IS AT HAND.
back_text:
Each [[Cultist]] enemy commits ritual suicide. Discard each [[Cultist]] enemy in play and move all doom from them to Azathoth. The lead investigator must search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of Daemonic Piping and draw it.
Endless walkways and steps of black stone are the only routes which guide you to your destination. It is an impossible maze to navigate.
Check Campaign Log. If Gilman's Journal is listed under "Mementos Discovered," you are able to find you way. Otherwise, you become hopelessly lost; each investigator must either move to the location to his or her left, or move the placement of his or her location once to the left (placing an empty space in the spot it previously occupied). A location cannot move more than once via this effect.
back_flavor: Somehow, you're not the only human here. They are but mindless husks - almost entirely devoid of humanity, nothing but flesh, muscle, and bone, preserved for eternity in their single-minded passion, kneeling and chanting in foul worship: "Azathoth! Azathoth! The end has come!"
back_name: Rejoice, For the End is Near!

name: It Awaits
text:
Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it.
Do not remove doom from enemies when this agenda advances.
real_text:
Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it.
Do not remove doom from enemies when this agenda advances.
flavor:
...the boundless daemon-sultan Azathoth, whose name no lips dare speak aloud, and who gnaws hungrily in inconceivable, unlighted chambers beyond time amidst the muffled, maddening beating of vile drums and the thin, monotonous whine of accursed flutes...
– H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
back_text:
Each [[Cultist]] enemy commits ritual suicide. Discard each [[Cultist]] enemy in play and move all doom from them to Azathoth. The lead investigator must search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of Daemonic Piping and draw it.
In this oblivion outside time, nothing is as it should be. The mist dances and churns around you. Laughter mocks you from beyond, and out from the dark nebulae emerges a familiar wraith, a being which should be long dead.
Check Campaign Log. If Worn Crucifix is listed under "Mementos Discovered," the wraith recognizes the crucifix you stole from Walter Gilman's room and backs away slowly, slinking into the darkness beyond. Otherwise, the wraith attacks you; each investigator must test [willpower] (4). Each investigator who fails takes 1 damage and 1 horror.

name: The Final Countdown
text: Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it. Do not remove doom from enemies when this agenda advances. (Beware - the scenario will not end when this agenda advances, but the doom of the world will be close at hand.)
real_text: Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it. Do not remove doom from enemies when this agenda advances. (Beware - the scenario will not end when this agenda advances, but the doom of the world will be close at hand.)
flavor:
...that leering, tittering shantak coursed on impetuous and relentless, flapping its great slippery wings in malignant joy, and headed for those unhallowed pits whither no dreams reach... 
– H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
back_text:
Each [[Cultist]] enemy commits ritual suicide. Discard each [[Cultist]] enemy in play and move all doom from them to Azathoth. The lead investigator must search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of Daemonic Piping and draw it. There is no longer an agenda deck, but the scenario is not over. Until the end of the scenario, doom that would be placed on the current agenda is instead placed on Azathoth, and all doom in play is considered to be on Azathoth.
You come across another circle of Azathoth's worshippers, led by a hooded, shapeless form which holds an ancient lantern high above its head. The lantern's dim grey light scarcely pierces the realm's darkness. Somehow, the phantom is familiar to you; some vague sense of kinship drives you onward.
Check Campaign Log. If Corn Husk Doll is listed under "Mementos Discovered," the creature recognizes you, as well. It peers at you curiously, and the circle of prayer is silenced; remove 1 doom from Azathoth. Otherwise, the creature barely notices you, and the circle resumes its chanting.

flavor: You are close now. You can feel the churning and twisting of aeons in the emptiness around you. Here, in the nucleus of all things — the very center of chaos itself — your objective, and your ultimate fate, lie at hand.

back_flavor:
You stand on a precipice before the Black Throne and gaze up at the blind, voiceless monstronsity that is Azathoth. The mere sight of it causes your vision to blur and your body to shake uncontrollably. The monotonous piping is so loud now, it rattles your bones and nearly causes you to vomit from the force upon your insides. Blood drips from your eyes and your ears.
Should Azathoth awaken, it will devour every world that ever was. You must act now, before it is too late.

back_flavor:
Somehow, despite all odds, you have managed to defeat the resurrected spirit which torments Anette Mason. She passes out and collapses to the ground, but the revenant inside forces her eyes open and puppeteers her body in a lurid display. "Fools!" the ragged, disembodied voice of Keziah declares through Anette's lips as she rises once more. "You are naught but insects. I have seen the truth. I have seen the face of Chaos itself, and you will soon be a part of it. Now, come; join me, kneel before the Black Throne, and be one with the universe!"
You shudder as the words reach your ears. Nothing she says makes sense to you, but you can tell her intent is dark and wicked. "Leave this place," you muster up the will to command, "Go back to the beyond from which you were summoned, and never return."

back_flavor:
Using force and ingenuity, you have managed to defeat Carl Sanford at his own game. The power he was drawing from surges painfully through him. "You imbeciles," he spits, "what do you think you have accomplished? We could have been immortal. Don't you understand? We could have been <u>gods</u>!" he struggles to remain on his feet, his strength waning as he loses control of his power.
"At what cost?" You reply, taking in the sight before you. "You would have made us slaves, not gods. Slaves to your greed and the Order's power. I'd rather stay mortal than be your thrall."
"Then we will all perish," Carl responds bitterly. "I could have made us into celestials. Instead we will be extinct. I hope you are satisfied."

back_flavor: Przez kilka ostatnich tygodni magazyny i doki Rivertown tonęły w szarej mgle, co spowodowało, że ta na co dzień spokojna dzielnica wydaje się jeszcze bardziej pusta i odludna.

name: Rivertown
text: [action]: Test [intellect] (2). For each point you succeed by, move 1 breach from Rivertown to the current act.
real_text: [action]: Test [intellect] (2). For each point you succeed by, move 1 breach from Rivertown to the current act.
back_flavor: These past few weeks, the warehouses and docks of Rivertown have been swathed in grey mist, making an already quiet district even more empty and desolate.

name: Southside
text: [free]: Odrzuć 3 wierzchnie karty z talii spotkań i porusz 1 pęknięcie z Southside na obecny akt. Wybierz kartę podstępu z cechą [[Moc]] odrzuconą w wyniku tego efektu i rozpatrz jej zdolność odkrycia, jeśli jakaś jest.
real_text: [free]: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck and move 1 breach from Southside to the current act. Choose a [[Power]] treachery discarded by this effect and resolve its revelation ability, if able.
back_flavor: Gdybyś był spoza Arkham, mógłbyś pomyśleć, że dzielnica Southside jest całkowicie wymarła. Wszyscy mieszkańcy ukryli się domach i zamknęli drzwi. Jedynym widocznym źródłem światła wydaje się katolicki kościół na południe stąd.

name: Southside
text: [free] Choose and discard any number of cards from your hand: For each card discarded in this way, move 1 breach from Southside to the current act.
real_text: [free] Choose and discard any number of cards from your hand: For each card discarded in this way, move 1 breach from Southside to the current act.
back_flavor: If you didn’t know any better, you would think Southside was a ghost town. All of the residents have retreated into their homes and locked their doors. The only light you see seems to be coming from the Catholic church to the south.

name: Uptown
text: [action] Wybierz i odrzuć kartę z twojej ręki: porusz 1 pęknięcie z Uptown na obecny akt oraz 1 dodatkowe pęknięcie za każdy symbol [agility] na danej karcie.
real_text: [action] Choose and discard a card from your hand: Move 1 breach from Uptown to the current act, +1 additional breach for each [agility] icon on that card.
back_flavor: Brukowane uliczki Uptown, najbezpieczniejszej z dzielnic Arkham, dzisiejszej nocy ujawniają zgoła odmienne oblicze. Pasma mgły wypływają z lasów na obrzeżach miasteczka, sięgając daleko poza Potok wisielca i płynąc mrocznymi ulicami.

name: Uptown
text: [action]: Test [agility] (2). For each point you succeed by, move 1 breach from Uptown to the current act.
real_text: [action]: Test [agility] (2). For each point you succeed by, move 1 breach from Uptown to the current act.
back_flavor: Typically a safe neighborhood, the cobbled streets of Uptown have taken a very different mood this night. Tendrils of mist reach out from the woods that border the town, stretching over Hangman’s Brook and crawling through the streets.

name: Południowy Kościół
text: [action]: Dobierz wierzchnią kartę z talii spotkań. Następnie porusz wszystkie pęknięcia z Południowego Kościoła na obecny akt. [action]: Zrezygnuj. Skrywasz się w mroku nocy.
real_text: [action]: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. Then, move all breaches from South Church to the current act. [action]: Resign. You hide through the night.
flavor: Wielu przestraszonych obywateli zasiadło na długich, kościelnych ławkach, modląc się i szepcąc pomiędzy sobą.
back_flavor: Fasada masywnego budynku góruje nad resztą Uptown. Blask prześwieca przez witrażowe okna. Ojciec Michael postawił sobie za punkt honoru, by kościół był otwarty bez względu na porę dnia i nocy i mimo dziwnych wydarzeń mających miejsce w całym mieście dzisiejszy wieczór niczym nie różni się w tym względzie od innych.

name: South Church
text: [action] Discard an asset you control from play: Move all breaches from South Church to the current act. [action]: Resign. You hide through the night.
real_text: [action] Discard an asset you control from play: Move all breaches from South Church to the current act. [action]: Resign. You hide through the night.
flavor: Many fearful citizens are seated at the church's wooden pews, praying and whispering amongst themselves.
back_flavor: The massive Romanesque building towers over the rest of Uptown, light shining from within its stained glass windows. Father Michael has made it a point to keep the church open at all hours, and despite the strange happenings throughout town, tonight is no different.

name: Dzielnica handlowa
text: [action] Odrzuć 5, 10 lub 15 wierzchnich kart z twojej talii: za każde 5 odrzuconych w ten sposób kart porusz 1 pęknięcie z Dzielnicy handlowej na obecny akt. Dobierz każde odrzucone w ten sposób osłabienie.
real_text: [action] Discard the top 5, 10, or 15 cards of your deck: For every 5 cards discarded in this way, move 1 breach from Merchant District to the current act. Draw each weakness discarded in this way.
back_flavor: Dzielnica handlowa stanowiąca centrum biznesowe Arkham tętni zwykle życiem bez względu na porę. Jednak dziś dokerzy i marynarze gdzieś zniknęli, co tylko zwiększa twój niepokój. Obserwowana z dala mgła unosząca się nad mrocznymi wodami rzeki Miskatonic wydaje się przybierać nienaturalne kształty.

name: Merchant District
text: [free] Spend 2 resources: Move 1 breach from Merchant District to the current act.
real_text: [free] Spend 2 resources: Move 1 breach from Merchant District to the current act.
back_flavor: The commercial center of Arkham, the Merchant District is usually bustling at all hours. But tonight, the dockhands and sailors have vanished, leaving you with a sense of unease. The mist over the dark waters of the Miskatonic River seems to take unnatural shapes as you watch from afar.

name: Wzgórze Wisielca
text: [action]: Przeszukaj talię spotkań i stos odrzuconych kart spotkań w poszukiwaniu wroga z cechą [[Wiedźma]]  i dobierz go. Następnie porusz wszystkie pęknięcia ze Wzgórza Wisielca na obecny akt. Potasuj talię spotkań.
real_text: [action]: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Witch]] enemy and draw it. Then, move all breaches from Hangman's Hill to the current act. Shuffle the encounter deck.
back_flavor: Kiedy ponownie podchodzisz do Wzgórza Wisielca, z cmentarza leżącego u jego podnóża zrywa się w niebo fala duchów. Istoty wyją potępieńczo w męczarniach, powoli otaczając miasto. Nawet ich krzyki układają się w swoistą melodię.

name: Loża Srebrnego Świtu
text: [free] Otrzymaj 1 punkt przerażenia: porusz 1 pęknięcie z Loży Srebrnego Świtu na obecny akt.
real_text: [free] Take 1 horror: Move 1 breach from Silver Twilight Lodge to the current act.
back_flavor: Kiedy ponownie podchodzisz do rezydencji Loży, orientujesz się, że jest ciemna i pusta. Wygląda na to, że członkowie organizacji wciąż pozostają w ukryciu, przynajmniej na ten moment.

name: Wzgórze Wisielca
text: [free] Otrzymaj 1 obrażenie: porusz 1 pęknięcie ze Wzgórza Wisielca na obecny akt.
real_text: [free] Take 1 damage: Move 1 breach from Hangman's Hill to the current act.
back_flavor: Kiedy ponownie podchodzisz do Wzgórza Wisielca, orientujesz się, że nic się tam nie dzieje. Żywi ani martwi nie nawiedzają tego miejsca. Wygląda na to, że sabat także je opuścił, przynajmniej na ten moment.

name: Loża Srebrnego Świtu
text: [action]: Przeszukaj talię spotkań i stos odrzuconych kart spotkań w poszukiwaniu wroga z cechą [[Srebrny Świt]]  i dobierz go. Następnie porusz wszystkie pęknięcia z Loży Srebrnego Świtu na obecny akt. Potasuj talię spotkań.
real_text: [action]: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Silver Twilight]] enemy and draw it. Then, move all breaches from Silver Twilight Lodge to the current act. Shuffle the encounter deck.
back_flavor: Kiedy ponownie podchodzisz do rezydencji Loży, jej okna są jasno oświetlone. Z wnętrza dobiega ledwie słyszalny, rytualny zaśpiew.

name: Chaos Manifest
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). Place 1 breach on X different random locations, where X is the amount by which you failed.
real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). Place 1 breach on X different random locations, where X is the amount by which you failed.
flavor: You look upon the face of true chaos. Everything you have ever known, everything you have ever loved - it is all meaningless by comparison.

name: Primordial Gateway
text: Revelation - Attach to a random location. Place breaches on attached location until there are exactly 3 breaches on it. Treat the attached location as if its printed text box were blank (except for [[Traits]]). [action]: Test [intellect] or [willpower] (4) to close the gateway. If you succeed, discard Primordial Gateway.
real_text: Revelation - Attach to a random location. Place breaches on attached location until there are exactly 3 breaches on it. Treat the attached location as if its printed text box were blank (except for [[Traits]]). [action]: Test [intellect] or [willpower] (4) to close the gateway. If you succeed, discard Primordial Gateway.

name: Terror Unleashed
text: Revelation - If there are no breaches on your location, place 1 breach on your location. You must take X damage or horror, divided as you wish. X is the total amount of doom and breaches on your location.
real_text: Revelation - If there are no breaches on your location, place 1 breach on your location. You must take X damage or horror, divided as you wish. X is the total amount of doom and breaches on your location.

name: Lodge Enforcer
text: Spawn - Most breaches (or Silver Twilight Lodge if there are no locations in play with breaches on them). Retaliate. Treat Lodge Enforcer's location as if its printed text box were blank (except for [[Traits]]).
real_text: Spawn - Most breaches (or Silver Twilight Lodge if there are no locations in play with breaches on them). Retaliate. Treat Lodge Enforcer's location as if its printed text box were blank (except for [[Traits]]).

name: Secrets of the Beyond
text: Revelation - Find the [[Cultist]] enemy in play with the most doom on it. For each doom on that enemy, place 1 breach on that enemy's location. If no breaches are placed by this effect, Secrets of the Beyond gains surge.
real_text: Revelation - Find the [[Cultist]] enemy in play with the most doom on it. For each doom on that enemy, place 1 breach on that enemy's location. If no breaches are placed by this effect, Secrets of the Beyond gains surge.

name: Witness of Chaos
text: Spawn - Fewest breaches. Hunter. Forced - After Witness of Chaos enters a location: Place 1 breach on that location.
real_text: Spawn - Fewest breaches. Hunter. Forced - After Witness of Chaos enters a location: Place 1 breach on that location.

name: Toil and Trouble
text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Resolve the revelation ability on the topmost [[Power]] treachery in the encounter discard pile. - Resolve an incursion at your location.
real_text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Resolve the revelation ability on the topmost [[Power]] treachery in the encounter discard pile. - Resolve an incursion at your location.

name: Tommy Muldoon
text:
[reaction] Kiedy atut, który kontrolujesz zostanie pokonany: zyskujesz X żetonów zasobów, gdzie X to łączna liczba obrażeń i punktów przerażenia na danym atucie. Wtasuj dany atut do twojej talii.
Efekt [elder_sign]: +2. Możesz poruszyć do 2 obrażeń i/lub punktów przerażenia z Tommy’ego Muldoona na kontrolowany przez ciebie atut lub z kontrolowanego przez ciebie atutu na Tommy’ego Muldoona.
real_text:
[reaction] When an asset you control is defeated: Gain X resources, where X is the total amount of damage and horror on that asset. Shuffle that asset into your deck.
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may move up to 2 damage and/or horror from Tommy Muldoon to an asset you control, or vice versa.
flavor: "Oczy dookoła głowy, Tommy."
back_text: Rozmiar talii: 30. Opcje tworzenia talii: karty Strażnika([guardian]) o poziomie 0-5, karty neutralne o poziomie 0-5, karty Ocalałego([survivor]) o poziomie 0-2. Wymogi tworzenia talii (nie wliczane do wielkości talii): Becky, Błąd żółtodzioba, 1 losowe podstawowe osłabienie.
back_flavor: Większość Muldoonów jest w jakiś sposób związana z policją. Nie tak dawno swoją odznakę otrzymał najmłodszy z braci, Tommy. Bystrooki, szaleńczo odważny i uzbrojony w niezawodną strzelbę Becky. Tommy chce się poświęcić egzekwowaniu prawa…Jednak gdy został wydelegowany do Biura Szeryfa w Arkham, odkrył, że nie jest wystarczająco przygotowany na przedziwne przestępstwa mające miejsce w tym zagadkowym mieście. Jednak niezależnie od tego czy miejscem zbrodni jest zadymiony nielegalny bard czy splamiony krwią ołtarz, Tommy nie spocznie, dopóki nie doprowadzi winowajcy przed oblicze sprawiedliwości.

name: Patrice Hathaway
text:
Maksymalna liczba kart na twojej ręce jest zmniejszona o 3.
Podczas fazy utrzymania, zamiast dobierać 1 kartę, odrzuć z twojej ręki wszystkie karty niebędące osłabieniami i dobieraj karty, dopóki nie będziesz miał ich 5 na ręce.
Efekt [elder_sign]: +1. Po zakończeniu tego testu możesz wtasować do twojej talii wszystkie karty z twojego stosu kart odrzuconych poza jedną.
real_text:
Your maximum hand size is reduced by 3.
During each upkeep phase, instead of drawing 1 card, discard all non-weakness cards in your hand and draw until you have 5 cards in hand.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. After this test ends, you may shuffle all but 1 card from your discard pile into your deck.
back_text: Rozmiar talii: 42. Opcje tworzenia talii: karty Ocalałego([survivor]) o poziomie 0-5, karty Mistyka([mystic]) o poziomie 0-2, karty neutralne o poziomie 0-5. Wymogi tworzenia talii (nie wliczane do wielkości talii): Skrzypce Patrice, Obserwator z innego wymiaru, 1 losowe podstawowe osłabienie.
back_flavor: Patrice całe życie poświęciła muzyce. Podnoszące na duchu sonaty, pełne gracji arie i gromkie marsze zawsze były jej najbliższymi towarzyszami. Jednak czasem, gdy gra, wyczuwa jakąś obcą obecność gdzieś na krańcach jej świadomości. Coś ją obserwuje i czeka. Coś, co łaknie. W ciągu ostatniego miesiąca dziwna obecność nieustannie rosła, a wynikające z tego zdenerwowanie nie pozwala Patrice grać na swych skrzypcach. Nie może na to dłużej pozwalać. Po ostatnim koncercie w Teatrze Warda w Arkham postanowiła, że pora wreszcie zacząć działać.

name: Becky
text: Tylko talia Tommy’ego Muldoona. Zużywalny (2 naboje). Każdy żeton zasobów zyskany w wyniku zdolności [reaction] Tommy’ego Muldoona może zostać zamiast tego umieszczony na Becky jako nabój. [action] Wydaj 1 nabój: Walka. Do tego ataku dostajesz +2 [combat] i zadajesz +1 obrażenie.
real_text: Tommy Muldoon deck only. Uses (2 ammo). Each resource gained from Tommy Muldoon's [reaction] ability may instead be placed on Becky, as ammo. [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.

name: Błąd żółtodzioba
text: Odkrycie - Odrzuć każdy kontrolowany przez ciebie atut, na którym znajdują się obrażenia lub punkty przerażenia. Jeśli w wyniku tego efektu nie zostaną odrzucone żadne atuty, wtasuj Błąd żółtodzioba z powrotem do twojej talii.
real_text: Revelation - Discard each asset you control with damage or horror on it. If no assets are discarded by this effect, shuffle Rookie Mistake back into your deck.

name: Skrzypce Patrice
text:
Tylko talia Patrice Hathaway.
[fast] Wybierz i odrzuć 1 kartę z twojej ręki i wyczerp Skrzypce Patrice: wybierz dowolnego badacza w twojej lokalizacji, aby zyskał 1 żeton zasobu albo dobrał 1 kartę..
real_text:
Patrice Hathaway deck only.
[fast] Choose and discard 1 card from your hand and exhaust Patrice's Violin: Choose an investigator at your location to either gain 1 resource or draw 1 card.

name: Obserwator z innego wymiaru
text: Zagrożenie. Ukryta. Łowca. Odkrycie - Dodaj tego wroga w tajemnicy do twojej ręki. Dopóki ten wróg znajduje się na twojej ręce, możesz z nim walczyć lub się mu wymykać (tak jakby znajdował się w twojej lokalizacji). Jeśli test zakończy się sukcesem, odrzuć go z twojej ręki. Jeśli test zakończy się porażką, rozstaw tego wroga w zwarciu z tobą. Wymuszony - Kiedy twoja talia się wyczerpie, jeśli ten wróg znajduje się na twojej ręce: atakuje cię (z twojej ręki).
real_text: Peril. Hidden. Hunter. Revelation - Secretly add this enemy to your hand. You may fight or evade this enemy while it is in your hand (as if it were at your location). If you succeed, discard it from your hand. If you fail, spawn it engaged with you. Forced - When your deck runs out of cards, if this enemy is in your hand: It attacks you (from your hand).

name: Ostrze żądzy
text: Limit 1 na talię. Jako dodatkowy koszt umieszczenia tej karty w grze, musisz przeszukać twoje powiązane karty w poszukiwaniu 3 kopii Żądzy krwi i wtasować je do twojej talii. [action]: Walka. Do tego ataku dostajesz +1 [combat] za każdą dołączoną kopię Żądzy krwi. Ten atak zadaje +1 obrażenie. Jeśli ten atak pokona wroga, umieść na tej karcie 1 żeton zasobu (z puli żetonów) jako ofiarę.
real_text: Limit 1 per deck. As an additional cost to play this card, you must search your bonded cards for 3 copies of Bloodlust and shuffle them into your deck. [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack for each attached copy of Bloodlust. This attack deals +1 damage. If this attack defeats an enemy, place 1 resource on this card (from the token bank), as an offering.

name: Żądza krwi
text: Powiązany (Ostrze żądzy). Odkrycie - Usuń 2 ofiary z Ostrza żądzy by dołączyć Żądzę krwi do Ostrza. Jeśli nie możesz tego zrobić, weź 1 przerażenie i wtasuj Żądzę krwi do twojej talii. [free] Kiedy atakujesz za pomocą Ostrza żądzy, wtasuj Żądzę krwi do twojej talii: zadajesz +1 obrażenie podczas tego ataku. (Maksimum raz na atak.)
real_text: Bonded (The Hungering Blade). Revelation - Remove 2 offerings from The Hungering Blade to attach Bloodlust to it. If you cannot, take 1 horror and shuffle Bloodlust back into your deck. [free] While attacking with The Hungering Blade, shuffle Bloodlust into your deck: You deal +1 damage for this attack. (Max once per attack.)

name: Uroczysta przysięga
text:
Niezliczone. Szybka.
Zagraj Uroczystą przysięgę pod kontrolę innego gracza w twojej lokalizacji.
[fast] Jeśli właściciel Uroczystej przysięgi znajduje się w twojej lokalizacji, wyczerp Uroczystą przysięgę: porusz 1 obrażenie lub punkt przerażenia z dowolnej karty, którą kontrolujesz, na dowolną kartę, którą kontroluje dany badacz.
real_text:
Myriad. Fast.
Play Solemn Vow under the control of another investigator at your location.
[fast] If the owner of Solemn Vow is at your location, exhaust Solemn Vow: Move 1 damage or horror from a card you control to a card that investigator controls.

name: Cząstka onyksu
text:
Niezliczone. Szybka.
[free] Jeśli posiadasz w grze 3 kopie Cząstki onyksu: odłóż je na bok, poza grę. Przeszukaj twoje powiązane karty w poszukiwaniu Wisiora królowej i umieść go w grze.
real_text:
Myriad. Fast.
[free] If you have 3 copies of Segment of Onyx in play: Set them aside, out of play. Search your bonded cards for Pendant of the Queen and put it into play.

name: Wisior królowej
text:
Powiązana (Cząstka onyksu). Zużywalny (3 ładunki). Jeśli na tej karcie nia ma żadnych ładunków, odłóż ją na bok, poza grę i wtasuj do twojej talii 3 odłożone na bok kopie Cząstek onyksu.
[free] Wyczerp Wisior królowej i wydaj 1 ładunek: wybierz dowolną odkrytą lokalizację i wybierz jedno – porusz się do danej lokalizacji, odkryj 1 żeton wskazówki w danej lokalizacji albo automatycznie wymknij się wrogowi w danej lokalizacji.
real_text:
Bonded (Segment of Onyx). Uses (3 charges). If this card has no charges, set it aside, out of play, and shuffle 3 set-aside copies of Segment of Onyx into your deck.
[free] Exhaust Pendant of the Queen and spend 1 charge: Choose a revealed location and select one - move to that location, discover 1 clue at that location, or automatically evade an enemy at that location.

name: Obserwacja gwiazd
text:
Maksymalnie 2 razy na grę.
Zagraj tylko, jeśli w talii spotkań znajduje się 10 lub więcej kart.
Przeszukaj twoje powiązane karty w poszukiwaniu 1 kopii karty Gwiazdy są w porządku i wtasuj ją do 10 wierzchnich kart talii spotkań.
real_text:
Max twice per game.
Play only if there are 10 or more cards in the encounter deck.
Search your bonded cards for 1 copy of The Stars Are Right and shuffle it into the top 10 cards of the encounter deck.

name: Gwiazdy są w porządku
text: Powiązany (Obserwacja gwiazd). Odkrycie - Usuń z gry Gwiazdy są w porządku. Wybierz badacza. Dany badacz dobiera 1 kartę, zyskuje 1 żeton zasobu i może wykonać natychmiastową akcję tak, jakby trwała jego tura (ta akcja nie wlicza się do liczby akcji, które dany badacz może wykonać w każdej turze).
real_text: Bonded (Stargazing). Revelation - Remove The Stars Are Right from the game. Choose an investigator. That investigator draws 1 card, gains 1 resource, and may take an immediate action as if it were their turn (this action does not count toward the number of actions that investigator can take each turn).

name: Otwarta brama
text:
Niezliczone. Szybka.
Zagraj tylko podczas twojej tury.
Dołącz do twojej lokalizacji. Limit grupowy 3 w grze.
Badacze mogą poruszać się między dowolnymi 2 lokalizacjami, do których dołączono Otwartą bramę, jakby te lokalizacje były połączone.
real_text:
Myriad. Fast.
Play only during your turn.
Attach to your location. Group limit 3 in play.
Investigators may move between any two locations with an attached Open Gate as if the locations were connected.

name: Panna Doyle
text: Limit 1 na talię. Wymuszony - Po tym jak Panna Doyle wejdzie do gry: przeszukaj twoje powiązane karty w poszukiwaniu Nadziei, Odwagi i Wyroczni. Losowo wybierz 1 by umieścić w grze i wtasuj pozostałe 2 do twojej talii. Kiedy Panna Doyle opuszcza grę, znajdz każdy z tych atutów (nawet jeśli są poza grą) i usuń je z gry.
real_text: Limit 1 per deck. Forced - After Miss Doyle enters play: Search your bonded cards for Hope, Zeal, and Augur. Randomly choose 1 to put into play and shuffle the other 2 into your deck. When Miss Doyle leaves play, find each of those assets (even if they are out of play) and set them aside, out of play.

name: Nadzieja
text: Powiązany (Panna Doyle). Szybka. Wymuszony - Po tym jak Nadzieja wejdzie do gry: odrzuć Odwagę i Wyrocznię. [action] Jeśli Nadzieja jest przygotowana, wyczerp lub odrzuć tę kartę: Wymykanie się. Rozpocznij próbę wymykania się z bazową wartością [agility] w wysokości 5. (Jeśli odrzuciłeś Nadzieję, ten test automatycznie kończy się sukcesem. Następnie, możesz wtasować Nadzieję do swojej talii by umieścić Odwagę lub Wyrocznię w grze z puli kart odrzuconych.)
real_text: Bonded (Miss Doyle). Fast. Forced - After Hope enters play: Discard Zeal and Augur. [action] If Hope is ready, exhaust or discard him: Evade. Attempt to evade with a base [agility] value of 5. (If you discarded Hope, this test is automatically successful. Then, you may shuffle Hope into your deck to put Zeal or Augur into play from your discard pile.)

name: Odwaga
text: Powiązany (Panna Doyle). Szybka. Wymuszony - Po tym jak Odwaga wejdzie do gry: odrzuć Nadzieję i Wyrocznię. [action] Jeśli Odwaga jest przygotowana, wyczerp lub odrzuć tę kartę: Walka. Zaatakuj wroga z bazową wartością [strenght] w wysokości 5. (Jeśli odrzuciłeś Odwagę, ten test automatycznie kończy się sukcesem. Następnie, możesz wtasować Odwagę do swojej talii by umieścić Nadzieję lub Wyrocznię w grze z puli kart odrzuconych.)
real_text: Bonded (Miss Doyle). Fast. Forced - After Zeal enters play: Discard Hope and Augur. [action] If Zeal is ready, exhaust or discard her: Fight. Fight with a base [combat] value of 5. (If you discarded Zeal, this test is automatically successful. Then, you may shuffle Zeal into your deck to put Hope or Augur into play from your discard pile.)

name: Wyrocznia
text: Powiązany (Panna Doyle). Szybka. Wymuszony - Po tym jak Wyrocznia wejdzie do gry: odrzuć Nadzieję i Odwagę. [action] Jeśli Wyrocznia jest przygotowana, wyczerp lub odrzuć tę kartę: Wymykanie się. Podejmij próbę wymykania się z bazową wartością [agility] w wysokości 5. (Jeśli odrzuciłeś Wyrocznię, ten test automatycznie kończy się sukcesem. Następnie, możesz wtasować Wyrocznię do swojej talii by umieścić Nadzieję lub Odwagę w grze z puli kart odrzuconych.)
real_text: Bonded (Miss Doyle). Fast. Forced - After Augur enters play: Discard Hope and Zeal. [action] If Augur is ready, exhaust or discard her: Investigate. Investigate with a base [intellect] value of 5. (If you discarded Augur, this test is automatically successful. Then, you may shuffle Augur into your deck to put Hope or Zeal into play from your discard pile.)

name: Mandy Thompson
text:
[reaction] Kiedy dowolny badacz w twojej lokalizacji miałby przeszukać swoją talię lub talię spotkań: może przeszukać 3 dodatkowe karty albo rozpatrzyć 1 dodatkowy cel danego przeszukiwania. (Limit raz na rundę).
Efekt [elder_sign]: +0. Przeszukaj 3 wierzchnie karty twojej talii w poszukiwaniu dowolnej karty i dobierz ją albo przeznacz do tego testu, jeśli to możliwe. Potasuj twoją talię.
real_text:
[reaction] When an investigator at your location would search their deck or the encounter deck: They may either search 3 additional cards or resolve 1 additional target of the search. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +0. Search the top 3 cards of your deck for a card and either draw it or commit it to this test, if able. Shuffle your deck.
back_text: Rozmiar talii: podczas tworzenia talii wybierz 30, 40 lub 50. Wybór drugorzędnej klasy: podczas tworzenia talii wybierz Mistyka ([mystic]), Łotra ([rogue]) lub Ocalałego ([survivor]). Opcje tworzenia talii: karty Poszukiwacza ([seeker]) o poziomie 0-5, karty neutralne o poziomie 0-5, do 10 kart wydarzeń i/lub umiejętności twojej wybranej drugorzędnej klasy o poziomie 0-1. Wymogi tworzenia talii (nie wliczane do wielkości talii): 1 kopia Dowodu okultyzmu (zamiast tego 2 kopie, jeśli rozmiar twojej talii to 40; zamiast tego 3 kopie, jeśli rozmiar twojej talii to 50), Szokujące odkrycie, 1 losowe podstawowe osłabienie.
back_flavor: Już od dziecka Mandy lubiła czytać, gdy nie mogła zasnąć. Czyli prawie co noc. Niesamowita pamięć i zdolność kojarzenia faktów pozwoliły jej stać się cenionym pracownikiem naukowym Uniwersytetu Miskatonic. Spędziła wiele godzin nad bluźnierczymi stronicami starożytnych, zakazanych pism, co pozwoliło jej odkryć pewien wzór mówiący o nadciągającym kataklizmie. Czy w końcu i ona zaczęła popadać w paranoję? A może ludzkości naprawdę grozi katastrofa na niewyobrażalną skalę?

name: Luke Robinson
text:
Rozpoczynasz grę z Pudełkiem z bramą w grze.
W każdej turze możesz zagrać jedno wydarzenie tak, jakbyś znajdował się w połączonej lokalizacji i był w zwarciu z każdym wrogiem w danej lokalizacji.
Efekt [elder_sign]: +1. Umieść 1 ładunek na Pudełku z bramą.
real_text:
You begin the game with Gate Box in play.
You may play one event each turn as if you were at a connecting location and engaged with each enemy at that location.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Place 1 charge on Gate Box.
flavor: „W każdym z nas kryje się klucz do Krain snów”.
back_text: Rozmiar talii: 30. Opcje tworzenia talii: karty Mistyka ([mystic]) o poziomie 0-5, karty Poszukiwacza ([seeker]) o poziomie 0-2, karty neutralne o poziomie 0-5. Wymogi tworzenia talii (nie wliczane do wielkości talii): Pudełko z bramą, Oderwany od rzeczywistości, 1 losowe podstawowe osłabienie.
back_flavor: Wiele lat temu Luke odkrył wejście do Krain snów. Otrzymał od swojego wuja niezwykle pudełko, dzięki któremu poznał sposób na podróżowanie do Bramy snu i z powrotem. Od tamtej pory większość swych dni spędzał na wędrowaniu i poszukiwaniu przygód w wyśnionym świecie. Przemierzał ulice Celephais i oglądał niezliczone cuda Zaczarowanego Lasu, odkrywając tajemnice tych ziem i niezliczonych śniących, którzy tam mieszkali. Teraz pradawny chaos próbuje zniszczyć nie tylko świat jawy, ale również świat z jego snów, a na to Luke nie może pozwolić.

name: Dowód okultyzmu
text:
Tylko talia Mandy Thompson.
Wtasuj dowód okultyzmu do twojej talii.
[reaction]Kiedy przeszukujesz twoją talię i Dowód okultyzmu znajduje się pośród przeszukiwanych kart, odkryj go: dobierz go i odkryj 1 żeton wskazówki w twojej lokalizacji (Maksymalnie 1 zdolność z karty z cechą [[Rozeznanie]] na przeszukiwanie.)
real_text:
Mandy Thompson deck only.
Shuffle Occult Evidence into your deck.
[reaction] When you search your deck and Occult Evidence is among the searched cards, reveal it: Draw it and discover 1 clue at your location. (Max one [[Research]] ability per search.)

name: Szokujące odkrycie
text: Odkrycie - Wtasuj Szokujące odkrycie z powrotem do twojej talii. (Jeśli nie możesz tego zrobić, zamiast tego odrzuć je i dobierz wierzchnią kartę talii spotkań). Wymuszony - Kiedy przeszukujesz twoją talię i ta karta znajduje się pośród przeszukiwanych kart: odrzuć ją. Anuluj to przeszukiwanie i wszystkie jego efekty. Potasuj przeszukaną talię. Dobierz wierzchnią kartę z talii spotkań.
real_text: Revelation - Shuffle Shocking Discovery back into your deck. (If you cannot, discard it and draw the top card of the encounter deck, instead.) Forced - When you search your deck and this card is among the searched cards: Discard it. Cancel the search and all of its effects. Shuffle the searched deck. Draw the top card of the encounter deck.

name: Pudełko z bramą
text: Tylko talia Luke'a Robinsona. Zużywalny (3 ładunki). [fast] Wyczerp Pudełko z bramą i wydaj 1 ładunek: uwolnij się ze zwarcia z każdym wrogiem będącym z tobą w zwarciu, przeszukaj twoje powiązane karty w poszukiwaniu Bramy snów (Niezwykła podróż), umieść ją w grze i porusz się na nią.
real_text: Luke Robinson deck only. Uses (3 charges). [fast] Exhaust Gate Box and spend 1 charge: Disengage from each enemy engaged with you, search your bonded cards for Dream-Gate (Wondrous Journey), put it into play, and move to it.

name: Oderwany od rzeczywistości
text: Odkrycie - Jeśli Brama snów (Niezwykła podróż) znajduje się już w grze, odwróć ją. W przeciwnym razie przeszukaj twoje powiązane karty w poszukiwaniu Bramy snów (Bezsensowna rzeczywistość) i umieść ją w grze. W obu przypadkach uwolnij się ze zwarcia z każdym wrogiem, z którym znajdujesz się w zwarciu, i porusz się na Bramę snów.
real_text: Revelation - If Dream-Gate (Wondrous Journey) is already in play, flip it over. Otherwise, search your bonded cards for Dream-Gate (Pointless Reality) and put it into play. In either case, disengage from each enemy engaged with you and move to Dream-Gate.

name: Brama snów
text: Powiązana (Pudełko z bramą). Brama snów jest połączona z każdą inną odkrytą lokalizacją i na odwrót. Wrogowie i badacze inni niż Luke Robinson nie mogą wejść do Bramy snów. Wymuszony - Koniec fazy badaczy: odłóż Bramę snów na bok, poza grę. (Jeśli znajduje się tu Luke Robinson, porusz go do dowolnej odkrytej lokalizacji).
real_text: Bonded (Gate Box). Dream-Gate is connected to each other revealed location, and vice versa. Enemies and investigators other than Luke Robinson cannot enter Dream-Gate. Forced - At the end of the investigation phase: Set Dream-Gate aside, out of play. (If Luke Robinson is here, move him to any revealed location.)

linked_card.name: Brama snów
linked_card.text:
Powiązana (Oderwany od rzeczywistości).

Wrogowie i badacze inni niż Luke Robinson nie mogą wejść do Bramy snów.

Po tym, jak uda ci się z sukcesem zbadać Bramę snów: odwróć ją.

Wymuszony - Koniec fazy badaczy: odłóż Bramę snów na bok, poza grę. (Jeśli znajduje się tu Luke Robinson, porusz go do dowolnej odkrytej lokalizacji i otrzymuje on 2 punkty przerażenia).
linked_card.real_text: Bonded (Detached from Reality). Enemies and investigators other than Luke Robinson cannot enter Dream-Gate. [reaction] After you successfully investigate Dream-Gate: Flip it. Forced - At the end of the investigation phase: Set Dream-Gate aside, out of play. (If Luke Robinson is here, move him to any revealed location, and he takes 2 horror.)

name: Brama snów
text: Powiązana (Oderwany od rzeczywistości). Wrogowie i badacze inni niż Luke Robinson nie mogą wejść do Bramy snów. [reaction] Po tym, jak uda ci się z sukcesem zbadać Bramę snów: odwróć ją. Wymuszony - Koniec fazy badaczy: odłóż Bramę snów na bok, poza grę. (Jeśli znajduje się tu Luke Robinson, porusz go do dowolnej odkrytej lokalizacji i otrzymuje on 2 punkty przerażenia).
real_text: Bonded (Detached from Reality). Enemies and investigators other than Luke Robinson cannot enter Dream-Gate. [reaction] After you successfully investigate Dream-Gate: Flip it. Forced - At the end of the investigation phase: Set Dream-Gate aside, out of play. (If Luke Robinson is here, move him to any revealed location, and he takes 2 horror.)

name: Zdumiewające odkrycie
text:
Niezliczone.
Zdumiewającego odkrycia nie można zagrać.
[reaction] Kiedy przeszukujesz twoją talię i pośród przeszukiwanych kart znajduje się Zdumiewające odkrycie, odrzuć je: zyskaj 2 żetony zasobów albo umieść 1 sekret na dowolnym atucie, który kontrolujesz. (Maksymalnie 1 zdolność z karty z cechą [[Rozeznanie]] na przeszukiwanie.)
real_text:
Myriad.
Astounding Revelation cannot be played.
[reaction] When you search your deck and Astounding Revelation is among the searched cards, discard it: Either gain 2 resources or place 1 secret on an asset you control. (Max one [[Research]] ability per search.)

name: Krystalizator snów
text:
Jako dodatkowy koszt umieszczenia tej karty w grze, musisz przeszukać twoje powiązane karty w poszukiwaniu 1 kopii Strażnika krystalizatora i wtasować ją do twojej talii.
[reaction] Po tym, jak zagrasz dowolne wydarzenie: zamiast je odrzucić, dołącz je zakryte do Krystalizatora snów (do maksimum 5 dołączonych wydarzeń). Dołączone wydarzenia mogą być przeznaczane do testów umiejętności tak, jakby znajdowały się na twojej ręce.
real_text:
As an additional cost to play this card, you must search your bonded cards for 1 copy of Guardian of the Crystallizer and shuffle it into your deck.
[reaction] After you play an event: Attach it facedown to Crystallizer of Dreams instead of discarding it (to a maximum of 5 attached events). Attached events may be committed to skill tests as if they were in your hand.

name: Strażnik krystalizatora
text: Powiązana (Krystalizator snów). Łowca. Polowanie - Tylko badacz z Krystalizatorem snów. Strażnik krystalizatora wchodzi do gry wyczerpany. Wymuszony - Jeśli w grze nie znajduje się Krystalizator snow: odłóż Strażnika krystalizatora nab ok, poza grę.
real_text: Bonded (Crystallizer of Dreams). Hunter. Prey - Investigator with a Crystallizer of Dreams only. Guardian of the Crystallizer enters play exhausted. Forced - If there is no Crystallizer of Dreams in play: Set Guardian of the Crystallizer aside, out of play.

name: Łatwy cel
text:
Niezliczone.
Zyskujesz 2 żetony zasobów i dobierasz 1 kartę.
[reaction] Po tym, jak zagrasz Łatwy cel: zagraj z twojej ręki kolejny Łatwy cel, nie płacąc jego kosztu.
real_text:
Myriad.
Gain 2 resources and draw 1 card.
[reaction] After you play Easy Mark: Play another Easy Mark from your hand, at no cost.

name: Przypadkowe odkrycie
text: Niezliczone. X to liczba innych kopii Przypadkowego odkrycia znajdujących się w twoim stosie kart odrzuconych. Badanie. Do tego badania dostajesz +X [intellect]. Jeśli test zakończy się sukcesem, odkryj w twojej lokalizacji X dodatkowych żetonów wskazówek.
real_text: Myriad. X is the number of other copies of Fortuitous Discovery in your discard pile. Investigate. You get +X [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, discover X additional clues at your location.

name: Egocentryzm
text: Tylko tryb wieloosobowy. Odkrycie - Umieść Egocentryzm w grze, w twoim obszarze zagrożenia. Nie możesz przeznaczać kart do testów umiejętności innych badaczy ani wpływać na innych badaczy efektami kart graczy (z wyjątkiem aspektów, które powodują obrażenia lub punkty przerażenia). [action] [action]: Odrzuć Egocentryzm.
real_text: Multiplayer only. Revelation - Put Self-Centered into play in your threat area. You cannot commit cards to other investigators' skill tests or affect other investigators with player card effects (except aspects that cause damage or horror). [action] [action]: Discard Self-Centered.

name: Kleptomania
text: Tylko tryb wieloosobowy. Odkrycie - Umieść Kleptomanię w grze, w twoim obszarze zagrożenia. [action]: Przejmij kontrolę nad dowolnym atutem z cechą [[Przedmiot ]] lub 2 żetonami zasobów innego badacza w twojej lokalizacji. Następnie wtasuj Kleptopanię do twojej talii. Wymuszony - Koniec twojej tury: otrzymujesz 1 punkt przerażenia.
real_text: Multiplayer only. Revelation - Put Kleptomania into play in your play area. [action]: Take control of an [[Item]] asset or 2 resources from another investigator at your location. Then, shuffle Kleptomania into your deck. Forced - At the end of your turn: Take 1 horror.

name: Narkolepsja
text: Tylko tryb wieloosobowy. Odkrycie - Umieść Nerkolepsję w grze, w twoim obszarze zagrożenia. Nie możesz wykonywać akcji, aktywować zdolności ani zagrywać kart. [action]: „Pobudka!” Odrzuć Narkolepsję. Wymuszony - Po tym, jak otrzymasz obrażenia lub przerażenia: odrzuć Narkolepsję.
real_text: Multiplayer only. Revelation - Put Narcolepsy into play in your threat area. You cannot take actions, trigger abilities, or play cards. [action]: "Wake up!" Discard Narcolepsy. Forced - After you take damage or horror: Discard Narcolepsy.

name: Twój najgorszy koszmar
text: Tylko tryb wieloosobowy. Łowca. Polowanie - Tylko posiadacz. Posiadacz Twojego najgorszego koszmaru nie może go atakować, zadawać mu obrażeń ani go pokonać.
real_text: Multiplayer only. Hunter. Prey - Bearer only. The bearer of Your Worst Nightmare cannot attack, damage, or defeat it.

name: Return to Curtain Call
text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Path to Carcosa Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Curtain Call shown here. - Construct the act deck using all six copies of Act 2a - "The Stranger." (Continued on reverse side.)
real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Path to Carcosa Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to Curtain Call shown here. - Construct the act deck using all six copies of Act 2a - "The Stranger." (Continued on reverse side.)
back_text: - Attach this card to Royal Emissary. It gains the following text: "This card cannot be detached from Royal Emissary (even if Royal Emissary leaves play). Forced - After Royal Emissary is added to the victory display: Place 1 resource on this card, as a warning. For each warning on this card, Royal Emissary gets +1 [per_investigator] health."

name: The Stranger
text: Objective - When The Man in the Pallid Mask would be discarded from play, advance.
real_text: Objective - When The Man in the Pallid Mask would be discarded from play, advance.
flavor: The mysterious Stranger from The King in Yellow might know something about what happened during the intermission. You must find and confront him if you are to discover the truth.
back_text: Instead of discarding The Man in the Pallid Mask, move him to the Lobby. Add 1 [cultist] and 1 [tablet] token to the chaos bag. Place 1 horror on Backstage. Until the end of the scenario, horror on locations represents the creeping mist, and each location with horror gains: "Forced - When you would leave this location: Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, you must either cancel the effects of the move or lose all remaining actions and end your turn after completing the effects of the move." Keep this card next to the act deck as a reminder, and advance to act 3a.
back_flavor: As you face off with the Stranger, you get the sense that he is grinning beneath his pale, faceless mask. "Where is everyone?" you ask, but he does not respond. "What is going on?" He remains silent and steps back as you approach, until his back is against the corner of the room. Suddenly, his body dissolves into a vortex of silvery mist, which slams into your body and knocks you to the floor before whirling past you and spreading into the air.

name: The Stranger

Until the end of the scenario, horror on locations represents entangling overgrowth, and each location with horror gains: "Forced - After you leave this location: Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, discard an [[Item]] or [[Ally]] asset you control (if you cannot, take 2 damage instead)." Keep this card next to the act deck as a reminder, and advance to act 3a.

He remains silent and steps back as you approach, until his back is against the corner of the room. The ground shakes, and you hear an uproarious collapse from above as vines, tree roots, and alien overgrowth tear into the ceiling of the room. You turn ack to the Stranger, but he is gone.

text: Objective - When The Man in the Pallid Mask would be discarded from play, advance.
real_text: Objective - When The Man in the Pallid Mask would be discarded from play, advance.

Until the end of the scenario, horror on locations represents the awful screeching of the Stranger, and each location with horror gains: "Forced - After you enter this location or end your turn at this location: Test [willpower] (2). If you fail, take 1 horror. (Limit once per round.)" Keep this card next to the act deck as a reminder, and advance to act 3a.

He remains silent and steps back as you approach, until his back is against the corner of the room. Then he opens his mouth and out emerges the most horrifying sound you have ever heard. It is as if the buzzing of a hundred locusts and the grating of rusted metal hide an even more terrible scream of pain and agony within. By the time you recover, the Stranger is gone.

name: Theatre Lounge
text: Forced - After you reveal the Theatre Lounge: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Search the encounter deck for the 2 topmost hidden cards and secretly add both of those cards to your hand. Shuffle the encounter deck.
real_text: Forced - After you reveal the Theatre Lounge: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Search the encounter deck for the 2 topmost hidden cards and secretly add both of those cards to your hand. Shuffle the encounter deck.
back_flavor: An ornate wooden door leads into one of the front areas of the theatre.

name: Prop Shop
text: While you are investigating Prop Shop, it gets -1 shroud for each horror on you. Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating the Prop Shop: Take 1 horror.
real_text: While you are investigating Prop Shop, it gets -1 shroud for each horror on you. Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating the Prop Shop: Take 1 horror.
back_flavor: A simple wooden door leads into the back of the theatre, far from the prying eyes of patrons.

name: La Comtesse
text: Spawn - Balcony. Hunter. Forced - After you defeat La Comtesse: Place her in your hand, as a hidden card. While La Comtesse is in your hand, she gains: "La Comtesse counts as 4 cards instead of 1 while checking your hand size. Forced - After you discard 1 or more cards from your hand during the upkeep phase: Take 1 horror."
real_text: Spawn - Balcony. Hunter. Forced - After you defeat La Comtesse: Place her in your hand, as a hidden card. While La Comtesse is in your hand, she gains: "La Comtesse counts as 4 cards instead of 1 while checking your hand size. Forced - After you discard 1 or more cards from your hand during the upkeep phase: Take 1 horror."

name: Return to The Last King
text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Path to Carcosa Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The Last King shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)
real_text: Perform the setup as indicated in The Path to Carcosa Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions: - When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The Last King shown here. (Continued on reverse side.)
back_text: - Remove Agenda 1a - "Fashionably Late" from the game and replace it with the new Agenda 1a - "Better Never Than Late." - Remove the original Dianne Devine from the game and replace it with the new version of Dianne Devine (Mercurial and Mischevious). - Place the 3 new "Sickening Reality" cards underneath the scenario reference card, along with the 5 original ones, for a total of 8. - Set the Shocking Display treachery aside, out of play.

name: Better Never Than Late
flavor: As you pull up to the manor, you notice that something is wrong. A trail of blood leads up the porch steps, and the front door is smashed. Muted music comes from within the house, its warped and discordant notes painful to your ears. Has the madness of <u>The King in Yellow</u> already made its way here?
back_text:

back_flavor: When you enter his cell, you find Daniel huddled in a corner of the room, sobbing and rocking back and forth on the ground. “No mask, no mask…” he stammers over and over. You help him to his feet and ask him what he remembers about The King in Yellow, but he interrupts you. “I already told you!” he exclaims frantically, his eyes wide with a yellow glow. “Don’t you remember? The last time you came here?” His words make no sense. You’ve only just arrived here…haven’t you? “No, no, no…” The man stammers, falling backward onto the dirty cot in the corner of his room. “It will never end. It will never end until HE is gone for good, and he will never be gone so long as you are here! Get me out! I want out—” Daniel screams for help, but the only response is the creature that suddenly emerges from beneath his cot. Before you can react, its tendrils have wrapped around his body, devouring him whole. His final screams are muffled by the creature’s enormity.

back_flavor: When you enter Daniel’s cell, you see him sitting on a chair facing the corner of his room. He is scrawling something on the wall, his expression calm. You ask him what he knows of The King in Yellow, and though he does not speak, you spot his reply written on the wall: “We both know how this ends.” Dumbfounded, you check the rest of his room. There are similar messages along the wall: “You already know of the oath,” “The price has been paid,” “The path has been opened again and again.” None of it makes any sense, but your instincts warn you there is more truth in these messages than there is lunacy. You help Daniel to his feet and try to usher him out of the room, hoping there is something you can do to help him.

name: Journey through the Gates
text: Forced - When doom is placed on this agenda during the mythos phase, if any investigator is at a [[Steps]] location: Place 1 additional doom on this agenda.
real_text: Forced - When doom is placed on this agenda during the mythos phase, if any investigator is at a [[Steps]] location: Place 1 additional doom on this agenda.
flavor: From your initial dream, you have been drawn into a familiar dreamscape: the same one that Virgil Gray traversed in his story in <u>Tales from Nevermore</u>. Is this real? Or is your mind simply conjuring what it expects to see?
back_text:
If it is act 1, 2, or 3, read the following:
The steps begin to twist like a snake uncoiling from its sleep. You try to keep your balance, but there is nothing for you to cling to for safety as the stairs tilt and flip.
Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma. Each of those investigators may test [willpower] (3) before being defeated to remember that this is all a dream. Each investigator who succeeds is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma, instead.
If it is act 4, read the following:
"Help! Please! Anyone!" The voice called out from the trees, far from the path. Normally, this sort of trick would not have fooled you, but the voice was too familiar to ignore. A loved one, perhaps, or someone you once failed in a time of need. It doesn't matter. It's too late now. You spin and look for the path, but it is nowhere to be found.
 Record in your Campaign Log the dreamers strayed from the path. Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.

name: Entering the Dreamlands
text: Do not draw cards from the encounter deck during the mythos phase. Objective - If an investigator enters The Cavern of Flame, immediately advance.
real_text: Do not draw cards from the encounter deck during the mythos phase. Objective - If an investigator enters The Cavern of Flame, immediately advance.
flavor: The door leading out of your initial dream takes you to a stone staircase. Thousands of different stairways join together here, forming an incomprehensible nexus of steps where worlds and stories join together. Where the stairs meet, they form a single spiraling pathway descending deeper into the land of dreams.
back_text:
Each investigator loses all of their clues.
Put the set-aside Nasht and Kaman-Thah enemies into play in The Cavern of Flame.
Your slumber grows deeper. Add 1 [skull] token to the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.
back_flavor: At the center of the cavern is a pillar of flame flanked by two robed, bearded men. You recognize this scene from the writings of Virgil Gray. The priests, the cavern: it is all just as he described. Either you have ventured into the same dreamscape, or you are sharing in his delusions. "You must be tested," one of the priests says enigmatically. "Your ordeal will be great, and thus, so too will be your trial."

name: The Trial of Nasht and Kaman-Thah
real_name: The Trial of Nasht and Kaman-Thah
text: Do not draw cards from the encounter deck during the mythos phase. Objective - If neither Nasht nor Kaman-Thah are in play, immediately advance.
real_text: Do not draw cards from the encounter deck during the mythos phase. Objective - If neither Nasht nor Kaman-Thah are in play, immediately advance.
flavor: The barred golden gates beyond will not open for you. Only the priests can judge whether you are worthy to pass through to the steps below. They cross their weapons - a steel halberd and a silver scythe - in front of the gates.
back_text:
Each investigator loses all of their clues.
Put the set-aside Seven Hundred Steps, Base of the Steps, and The Enchanted Path locations into play.
Your slumber grows deeper. Add 1 [skull] token to the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.
back_flavor: Satisfied that you are worthy to enter the Dreamlands, the priests step aside to let you pass, and the gate beyond opens. Before you step through, one of them grabs you by the wrist and gives you a final warning: "Your journey shall take you beyond the lands of the gods. The eye of chaos is upon you now. Follow the path, and you shall be safe. But beware!" He tightens his grip. "Stray not from the path!"

name: The Final Descent
text: Do not draw cards from the encounter deck during the mythos phase. Objective - If each investigator is at The Enchanted Path, immediately advance.
real_text: Do not draw cards from the encounter deck during the mythos phase. Objective - If each investigator is at The Enchanted Path, immediately advance.
flavor: Spiraling stairs descend below for what seems like an infinity.
back_text: Each investigator loses all of their clues. Your slumber grows deeper. Add 1 [skull] token to the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign. Remove each [[Steps]] location from the game. Randomly choose 6 of the set-aside Enchanted Woods locations to put into play. Remove the other copy from the game. Shuffle all of the remaining set-aside scenario cards, except for Laboring Gug and Randolph Carter (Expert Dreamer), to form the encounter deck. (From now on, investigators draw cards from the encounter deck during each mythos phase, as normal.)
back_flavor: When you reach the base of the stairway, you find yourself in an otherworldly oak forest. The forest floor is thick with countless years of fallen leaves, and you are surrounded by glowing fungi of all shapes and sorts. The soil is pierced with gnarled roots, and the trees are strangled by invasive vines. A winding dirt path leads deeper into the woods.

name: The Path
text: Forced - After the first time any investigator enters an Enchanted Woods location: Record in your Campaign Log the dreamers strayed from the path. Objective - Only investigators at The Enchanted Path may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
real_text: Forced - After the first time any investigator enters an Enchanted Woods location: Record in your Campaign Log the dreamers strayed from the path. Objective - Only investigators at The Enchanted Path may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: All you have to do is stay on the path.
back_text: The investigators must decide (choose one): - Step back and watch this surreal scene play out. (→R1) - Interrupt the scarred cat and handle this yourself. (→R2)
back_flavor: As you near the edge of the wood, more of the rodent-like creatures emerge, swarming out of burrows and honeycombed trees. Soon, the whole forest is alive with them. They surround you and chitter in a language you somehow understand: "Intruders." "They are with the cats." "New dreamers." "No, they followed the black cat." "But the black cat is not here." "We are many; they are few." Several of them emit low growls as they begin to close in. ust then, you hear a human voice call out, "What is the meaning of all this?" The owner of the voice is a blond young man with an unfazed expression. He is flanked by a pack of angry cats, each of whom falls into step beside him, save for one scarred old cat who takes the lead. You realize that the man speaks not to you, but to the creatures all around you, who slink backward as they are scolded. Then, to your ever-growing surprise, the scarred cat speaks: "Your tribute is late!"

name: Seventy Steps
text: Forced - When you leave the Seventy Steps: Take 1 horror for each card in your hand in excess of 5. [free]: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand.
real_text: Forced - When you leave the Seventy Steps: Take 1 horror for each card in your hand in excess of 5. [free]: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand.
back_flavor:
You are no longer in your own world.
A spiral of twisting stone steps hang suspended in the aether with no visible means of support. At the bottom of the steps, there is an island landing, also floating in the void, where a tall, golden gateway leads into a brightly lit cavern.

name: The Cavern of Flame
text: Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Each investigator in The Cavern of Flame takes 1 damage.
real_text: Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Each investigator in The Cavern of Flame takes 1 damage.

linked_card.name: The Trial of Kaman-Thah
linked_card.text:
If you parleyed with Kaman-Thah, read the following:

"Your mind is strong," the guardian admits, " but are you ready to shed your concept of truth? Of reality? If so, alter your clothing." You protest out of confusion. "This is a land of wills," the priest continues. "If your resolve is truly strong enough, prove it to me." You close your eyes and imagine a different outfit, straining to recall its texture, its color, its smell. Each and every thread of fabric. When you open your eyes, you are wearing it. "Good," Kaman-Thah says, stepping aside.

Add this card to the victory display.

If you defeated Kaman-Thah, read the following:

The priest entertains your silly notion of resistance for a few moments before his eyes turn fiery. He is completely unharmed. "You are fierce. But ferocity will only get you so far. You may pass, but heed me: Not all problems can be solved with violence."

Add this card to the victory display.

linked_card.name: The Trial of Nasht
linked_card.text:
If you parleyed with Nasht, read the following:

"Your quest will lead to death," the priest foretells. "Prove that you can survive what is to come, and I shall let you pass. Show me your weapon." You open your hand and reveal the first weapon that comes to your mind. Nasht slaps it out of your hand. "That is not a weapon. Show me your true weapon." You think for a moment. What weapon could the guardian possibly be referring to? What weapon could help you survive a place like this? Then the answer hits you, plain as day. You point to your temple, and Nasht nods. "Very well."

Add this card to the victory display.

If you defeated Nasht, read the following:

The guardian dismisses you with a gentle wave of his hand, and you are sent hurtling into the wall of the cavern. "Your eyes mistake me for a feeble old man. This is your lesson: Do not trust your eyes, for they will lie to you." He steps aside to let you pass.

name: Halls of St. Mary's
flavor: A heavy, ominous feeling haunts you as you explore St. Mary’s Hospital. Its halls are eerily dark and empty of everything but the occasional orderly making the late-night rounds. Lights flicker, and shadows seem to dart from corner to corner. The hospital’s maze of corridors has begun to take on an almost dreamlike haziness. You notice yet another spider crawling up your leg and brush it away, wondering what is causing them to appear so often.
back_text: Shuffle the set-aside Spiders encounter set and each set-aside copy of Outbreak into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile. Draw the set-aside The Infestation Begins story card and resolve its text.
back_flavor: As you continue to explore the hospital, the oddities you have observed become more and more frequent. Thick, dark cobwebs now cover the corners of every room. Spiders crawl along the walls and the ceilings, emerging from seemingly nowhere and vanishing just as quickly. It's not just your imagination - an infestation of spiders has taken root within the hospital. And not just any spiders: they are larger than average, with long, jagged, barbed legs and great hairy abdomens. Perhaps even more worrying is the complete lack of hospital staff roaming the halls. Aside from several wary and frightened orderlies, you see no other staff members, not even any nurses or doctors. Where has everyone gone?

name: The Infestation Spreads
text: Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Make an infestation test.
real_text: Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Make an infestation test.
flavor: A monstrous presence has infested St. Mary’s. It lies inside the walls and watches you from all sides. In mere minutes, it has spun thick, sticky webbing throughout each of the rooms you visit. The lights are either flickering or out across the hospital, and some of the more advanced medical machinery is broken and covered in cobwebs.
back_text: Find each Suspicious Orderly enemy in play and replace it with a set-aside Corrupted Orderly enemy (it keeps its game state, all tokens, and all attachments). Search the encounter deck and discard pile for each copy of Suspicious Orderly and remove them from the game. Shuffle the set-aside Agents of Atlach-Nacha encounter set, each remaining set-aside Corrupted Orderly enemy, and the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Add 1 [skull] token and 1 [cultist] token to the infestation bag.
back_flavor: Suddenly, chaos breaks out in the hospital. THe sound of chittering and crashing emerges from the walls. In the darkness, you can barely make out the shapes of bizarre spiderlike creatures scurrying in the distance. As you round a corner, you spot an orderly writhing on the polished floor, convulsing violently as though possessed by an insidious force. You rush to his side and flip him onto his back... and find that nearly all of his face is covered in thick webbing, and his eyes are wide and glazed over. He does not react as you shake him.

name: Hospital of Horrors
text: Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Make an infestation test. Each [[Spider]] enemy at an infested location gets +1 fight and +1 evade.
real_text: Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Make an infestation test. Each [[Spider]] enemy at an infested location gets +1 fight and +1 evade.
flavor: The entire building has become infested with a sinister evil - something that does not follow the laws of nature. You need to find some way to either stop it or to escape before it consumes you, too.
back_text: In your Campaign Log, record 8 tally marks next to "Steps of the Bridge." (→R4)
back_flavor: The infestation has claimed the hospital in its entirety. Not a single room has been left untouched. You race through its halls, searching desperately for a way out, and find only web-covered walls, victims wrapped in silken cocoons, and dead hospital staff hanging from the ceiling.

name: Looking for Answers
flavor: Something is wrong with your companions, and while medical science has come far, it can’t account for what is happening to them. You’ve decided to take it upon yourself to figure out what is wrong and set things right.
back_text:
Put the set-aside Stairwell and Basement Door locations into play.
Check the current agenda.
- If it is agenda 2 or 3, make an infestation test.
- If it is agenda 1, immediately advance to agenda 2.
back_flavor: From hospital records and snippets of hushed conversation, you are able to glean that there was recently another patient in the hospital whose condition closely mirrored that of your friends. After being comatose for weeks, the patient abruptly and inexplicably awakened just this morning. Baffled, the doctors have quarantined the patient somewhere in the basement of the hospital, below the eastern ward.

name: Search for the Patient
text: Objective - If an investigator controls Randolph Carter, advance.
real_text: Objective - If an investigator controls Randolph Carter, advance.
flavor: You need to learn where this mysterious patient is being kept. If you can find them and speak with them, perhaps they can provide some answers about what is happening to your friends.
back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
back_flavor: After some persuading, you manage to convince the blond-haired man to listen to your story. Once you explain to him what has happened to your companions, he shakes his head in solemn understanding. "I knew this Virgil fellow would cause trouble. If only I had convinced him not to write that story..." You ask him what he means, and he lets out a long sigh before elaborating: "It's all true. All of it. The Dreamlands is real. And I believe that something is causing it to merge with the waking world. That's where all of this is coming from," he explains, motioning to the spiderwebs in the corners of the room. "With your help, I may be able to temporarily stop the infestation from spreading. Then we can investigate this matter further." He rises from his cot and shakes your hand. "My name is Randolph, by the way. Randolph Carter."

name: Containing the Outbreak
text: Each infested location gains: "[action]: Test [willpower] (X) to attempt to seal the rift. X is this location's shroud. Investigators at this location may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to automatically succeed. If you succeed, replace the damage token on this location with a horror token. For the remainder of the game, this location cannot become infested." Objective - If there are no infested locations in play, advance.
real_text: Each infested location gains: "[action]: Test [willpower] (X) to attempt to seal the rift. X is this location's shroud. Investigators at this location may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to automatically succeed. If you succeed, replace the damage token on this location with a horror token. For the remainder of the game, this location cannot become infested." Objective - If there are no infested locations in play, advance.
flavor: With the aid of Randolph Carter, you must attempt to close the rifts that have opened between the Dreamlands and the waking world.
back_text: Check Campaign Log. - If Dr. Maheswaran joined the investigation and she was in play when the scenario ended, (→R1). - If Dr. Maheswaran joined the investigation and she was not in play when the scenario ended, (→R2). - If Dr. Maheswaran stayed with her patients , (→R3).
back_flavor: With the final rift sealed, the infestation ceases, and the hospital returns to normal. "Good work," Randolph says. "Still, I believe this matter warrants further investigation. We do not know what caused this to happen." You remind him that there is also the matter of your companions, who still refuse to wake. "Yes, of course— that too. Come, let us go somewhere private where we can discuss what our next step should be. Sadly, I do not believe there is anything more we can do to aid your friends here." You don't know if Randolph means "here" as in "the hospital" or "here" as in "the waking world," but either way, it does not bode well for your companions.

name: Poczekalnia
text: Dopóki Poczekalnia nie jest opanowana przez plagę, zyskuje: „[action]: Rezygnacja. Uciekacie ze szpitala, pozostawiając waszych towarzyszy na pastwę losu”.
real_text: While Waiting Room is not infested, it gains: "[action]: Resign. You flee the hospital, leaving your companions behind."
flavor: W rogu okna na szybie rozciąga się jedwabna sieć, utkana jakby samoistnie. Czy była tu już, kiedy przyjechałeś...?
back_flavor: Szpitalna poczekalnia jest przytulna, ale monotonna - wypełnia ją kilka rzędów ławek i krzeseł. W pobliżu stoi niski regał wypełniony przeróżnymi czasopismami i książkami, z których większość wydaje się okropnie nudna.

name: Oddział nagłych wypadków
text: Dopóki znajdujesz się na Oddziale nagłych wypadków, każdy z twoich testów umiejętności dostaje +1 do trudności za każdą przeznaczoną do niego kartę.
real_text: While you are in the Emergency Room, each of your skill tests gets +1 difficulty for each card committed to it.
flavor: W całym pomieszczeniu są ślady jakiegoś wyjątkowo makabrycznego zabiegu. Materac na środku sali zachlapany jest zaschniętą krwią, a na podłodze wokół walają się przybory medyczne - bandaże, gazy i strzykawki.
back_flavor: Zaglądasz na oddział nagłych wypadków i zauważasz, że znajduje się tu kilka innych sal oprócz tej, w której są trzymani twoi towarzysze.

name: Oddział terapii eksperymentalnych
text: [reaction] Kiedy badasz Oddział terapii eksperymentalnych, otrzymaj 1 punkt przerażenia: do tego badania Oddział terapii eksperymentalnych dostaje -2 do wartości zasłony.
real_text: [reaction] When you investigate Experimental Therapies Ward, take 1 horror: Experimental Therapies Ward gets -2 shroud for this investigation.
flavor: Sala wypełniona jest łóżkami, a każde z nich otoczono oddzielającą zasłoną. Obok łóżek stoją nowoczesne maszyny, gotowe do poddania pacjentów wszelkim rodzajom radykalnych terapii.
back_flavor: Znak nad wejściem do tej sali głosi: „Terapie eksperymentalne”. Nie jesteś pewien, z jakiego rodzaju lekami eksperymentuje personel szpitala św. Marii, i nie jesteś pewien, czy chcesz to wiedzieć.

name: Archiwum akt
text: [action] [action] [action] Jeśli nie jesteś w zwarciu z żadnymi wrogami: wykonaj 4 podstawowe akcje badania (po jednej na raz).
real_text: [action] [action] [action] If you are not engaged with any enemies: One at a time, take 4 basic investigate actions.
