name: Gnashing Teeth
text: Each [[Risen]] enemy and each [[Ghoul]] enemy gains "Spawn - Random location."
real_text: Each [[Risen]] enemy and each [[Ghoul]] enemy gains "Spawn - Random location."
flavor: Everywhere you go, you have the distinct feeling of being followed, as though the shadows themselves move of their own accord. In nearby alleyways and backroads, you hear the gnashing of teeth and the tearing of meat. The palpable sense of unease only grows stronger as night falls.
back_text:
For every 1 [per_investigator] civilians slain, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Risen]] or [[Ghoul]] enemy and spawn it. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
Each investigator decides (choose one):
- Heal 2 damage from each [[Elite]] enemy in play.
- 1 civilian at your location is slain.
back_flavor: As night falls, your sense of being followed only grows. Turning around, you see a trio of tall, lanky figures moving slowly. The shadows obscure their features, but a glint of light reflects on wet, red jaws and hollow eyes. When you quicken your pace, they quicken theirs. As the group bears down on you, you duck into a nearby alleyway and sprint away from them. After several minutes of running, you hear a rasping, gutteral howl followed by a sound like ripping cloth behind you.

name: Empty Streets
text: Each [[Risen]] enemy and each [[Ghoul]] enemy gains hunter and "Spawn - Random location."
real_text: Each [[Risen]] enemy and each [[Ghoul]] enemy gains hunter and "Spawn - Random location."
flavor: The city grows quieter as more and more civilians disappear each night. The soul-deadening heat of the day sees more hollow-eyed figures walk the streets. Once a thriving oasis of life and culture, Marrakesh now feels like an empty echo of its former self.
back_text: Each investigator suffers 1 physical trauma. Check which enemies are in play. - If Razin Farhi is in play, proceed to (→R1) (page 13). - Otherwise, proceed to (→R2) (page 13).
back_flavor:
A crimson sunrise casts the ruined city in an awful glow: cars overturned, stalls rared, cobblestones covered in blood smears. What few civilians remain cower behind boarded up windows, fearfully praying for their lives. Whatever terrible thing Amaranth aimed to do here, she has succeeded. The city's ruin is a grim testament to her awful power.
Heart heavy with the weight of such great loss, you make a path through the devastation. A pack of the hungering dead catch wind of your scent and pursue you relentlessly to the city limits, picking at you with sharp, hungry claws. You barely escape with your life.

name: Find Amaranth
text: Objective - At the end ot the round, investigators at a [[Ritual Site]] location may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
real_text: Objective - At the end ot the round, investigators at a [[Ritual Site]] location may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: Strange happenings are afoot. A tomb robbery of an ancient philosopher. Rumors of the dead walking the streets. A string of disappearances. If you can gather information on Amaranth's whereabouts, you may be able to get to the bottom of things.
back_text: Spawn the set-aside Amaranth enemy at Bahia Palace Gardens, (Lurking Corruption) side faceup, and attach the set-aside The Last Blossom key to her. Put the set-aside Save the Civilians story card into play next to the agenda deck. Shuffle the set-aside Khalid enemy into the encounter deck.
back_flavor:
Showing the photograph of Amaranth to several locals, they direct you to the verdant Bahia Palace Gardens. Approaching carefully, you find the woman with the red flower standing at the edge of a ritual circle, candles lit at each point, with gleaming offerings gathered around a corpse laid on an altar in the center. On either side of the corpse, two dead warriors are laid on the ground, bedecked in ancient finery.
"Soon, my love," Amaranth strokes the cheek of the corpse as the blossom in her hair unfurls. Tenebrous vines radiate out from the circle and creep across the garden. The grass and greenery shrivel under their touch, and eerie green light shimmers up the black vines, drinking the life around it. "It appears we have guests," Amaranth smirks.

name: Ritual of Life and Death
text: Forced - After a civilian is slain, if 4[per_investigator] or more civilians have been slain: Advance this act. Objective - If Amaranth would be defeated, advance.
real_text: Forced - After a civilian is slain, if 4[per_investigator] or more civilians have been slain: Advance this act. Objective - If Amaranth would be defeated, advance.
flavor: A network of necrous vines has grown through the city, spurred on by Amaranth. The woman with the red flower is conducting strange rites upon a stolen corpse in the Bahia Palace Gardens. You must stop her at any cost.
back_text:
If this act advanced because of its forced ability:
"Razin, my love!" exclaims Amaranth. The body in the ritual circle rises to stand, along with two newly-resurrected warriors. Amaranth embraces the ancient philosopher, the two of them entwined with awful black tendrils. She speaks softly: "Let me make this place a paradise for you, my love. A true paradise."
Spawn the set-aside Razin Farhi enemy at Bahia Palace Gardens. Shuffle both copies of the set-aside Ancient Raider enemy into the encounter deck.
If this act advanced because Amaranth would be defeated:
Your final blow knocks Amaranth back, toppling an ancient brazier. As hungry flames consume the remnants of the ritual and the corpses, she screeches in anguish. "Do you have any idea what you have done? Razin, my love..."
Flip Amaranth to her (Corruption Revealed) side, keeping all tokens and attachments on her, and move her to a random location with no investigators. Shuffle both copies of the set-aside Ancient Raider enemy into the encounter deck.

name: Queen of Nothing at All
text: Objective - If neither Amaranth nor Razin Farhi are in play, advance.
real_text: Objective - If neither Amaranth nor Razin Farhi are in play, advance.
flavor: Unnatural vines choke the city streets as Amaranth pursues you, drunk with power. The blossom in her hair stretches wide like a garnet maw as she laughs cruelly.
back_text: Check your Campaign Log. - If the cell knows Amaranth's real name, proceed to (→R3) (page 13). - Otherwise, proceed to (→R4) (page 13).
back_flavor:
Amaranth's tortured cry resounds through the streets as she collapses. A heady wind picks up, whipping the dust in the street into a frantic dervish as the hot sun beats down overhead. Black ichor pools around Amaranth's body as the nexus of vines begins to wither and dessicate around you. The hordes of risen dead stop in their tracks, as if waiting for your move. You can see the remaining civilians of Marrakesh flee the city beyond them.
Standing over the beautiful, terrible woman, you feel a pang of pity. As you turn her over, you notice the voluptuous flower behind her ears has wilted in the heat. She lets out a primal scream as you pull the blossom from her ear: the stem is several inches longer than you expected, and sticky with blood.

name: Dworzec kolejowy w Marrakeszu
text: [fast]: Ruch (do połączonej lokalizacji). (Limit grupowy raz na turę). [action]: Rezygnacja. Uciekasz z miasta. (Uwaga: Jeśli w grze nie ma już żadnych badaczy, wszyscy pozostali cywile zostaną zgładzeni). Wymuszony - Jeśli na Dworcu kolejowym w Marrakeszu nie znajdują się żadni cywile: podmień go na jego odłożoną na bok wersję z cechą [[Opuszczona]].
real_text: [fast]: Move (to a connecting location). (Group limit once per turn.) [action]: Resign. You flee the city. (Note: If there are no investigators in play, all remaining civilians in play will be slain.) Forced - If Marrakesh Railway Station has no civilians on it: Swap it with its set-aside [[Abandoned]] version.
back_text: Wymuszony - Jeśli na Dworcu kolejowym w Marrakeszu nie znajdują się żadni cywile: podmień go na jego odłożoną na bok wersję z cechą [[Opuszczona]].
back_flavor: Twoje pierwsze wrażenie Marrakeszu jest pozytywne: od delikatnego, suchego upału po uderzającą mauretańską architekturę i kolorowe kafelki. Wyczuwasz jednak jakiś niewypowiedziany strach wśród otaczających cię ludzi.

name: Plac Dżami al-Fana
text: [action] Jeśli w tej lokalizacji znajduje się 1 lub więcej cywilów: odkryj 6 wierzchnich kart z twojej talii. Możesz zagrać dowolny atut spośród danych kart (płacąc jego koszt). Wtasuj pozostałe karty do twojej talii. (Limit raz na grę). Wymuszony - Jeśli na Placu Dżami al-Fana nie znajdują się żadni cywile: podmień go na jego odłożoną na bok wersję z cechą [[Opuszczona]].
real_text: [action] If 1 or more civilians are on this location: Reveal the top 6 cards of your deck. You may play an asset from among those cards (paying its cost). Shuffle the rest into your deck. (Limit once per game.) Forced - If Jemaa el-Fnaa Square has no civilians on it: Swap it with its set-aside [[Abandoned]] version.
back_text: Wymuszony - Jeśli na Placu Dżami al-Fana nie znajdują się żadni cywile: podmień go na jego odłożoną na bok wersję z cechą [[Opuszczona]].
back_flavor: Ten ogromny targ na świeżym powietrzu, będący centrum handlowym Marrakeszu, jest miejscem, w którym można zaopatrzyć się w żywność i niezbędne zapasy. Powietrze wypełnia muzyka, zapach przypraw i pieczonego mięsa.

name: Nekropolia Sadytów
text: Nekropolia Sadytów dostaje +1 do wartości zasłony za każdego znajdującego się na niej cywila. Wymuszony - Kiedy nie-[[Elitarny]] wróg wchodzi do Nekropolii Sadytów lub zostaje w niej rozstawiony, zanim wejdzie w zwarcie z dowolnym badaczem: wyczerp danego wroga. Wymuszony - Jeśli w Nekropolii Sadytów nie znajdują się żadni cywile: podmień ją na jej odłożoną na bok wersję z cechą [[Opuszczona]].
real_text: Saadian's Tombs gets +1 shroud for each civilian on it. Forced - When a non-[[Elite]] enemy enters or spawns at Saadian's Tombs, before it engages any investigators: Exhaust it. Forced - If Saadian's Tombs has no civilians on it: Swap it with its set-aside [[Abandoned]] version.
back_text: Wymuszony - Jeśli w Nekropolii Sadytów nie znajdują się żadni cywile: podmień ją na jej odłożoną na bok wersję z cechą [[Opuszczona]].
back_flavor: Królewska nekropolia dynastii Sadytów jest miejscem ostatniego spoczynku większości członków rodziny królewskiej Maroka z XVI wieku. Część zdobiących to miejsce pięknych kafelków została zniszczona podczas niedawnego włamania.

name: Garbarnie
text: [fast] Wybierz wroga z cechą [[Wskrzeszony]] ze stosu odrzuconych kart spotkań i rozstaw go w zwarciu z tobą: umieść na Garbarniach żetony wskazówek (z puli żetonów) w liczbie równej wytrzymałości danego wroga. Wymuszony - Jeśli w Garbarniach nie znajdują się żadni cywile: podmień je na ich odłożoną na bok wersję z cechą [[Opuszczona]].
real_text: [fast] Choose a [[Risen]] enemy from the encounter discard pile and spawn it engaged with you: Place clues on Tanneries (from the token pool) equal to that enemy's health. Forced - If Tanneries has no civilians on it: Swap it with its set-aside [[Abandoned]] version.
back_text: Wymuszony - Jeśli w Garbarniach nie znajdują się żadni cywile: podmień je na ich odłożoną na bok wersję z cechą [[Opuszczona]].
back_flavor: Docierają do ciebie doniesienia o dziwnych zaginięciach w pobliżu garbarni, w których skóra jest obrabiana w dużych kadziach pełnych silnych chemikaliów i barwników.

name: Ogrody pałacu Bahia
text: [reaction] Po tym, jak uratujesz cywila w Ogrodach pałacu Bahia: wylecz 1 obrażenie lub 1 punkt przerażenia. Wymuszony - Jeśli w Ogrodach pałacu Bahia nie znajdują się żadni cywile: podmień je na ich odłożoną na bok wersję z cechą [[Opuszczona]].
real_text: [reaction] After you rescue a civilian on Bahia Palace Gardens: Heal 1 damage or 1 horror. Forced - If Bahia Palace Gardens has no civilians on it: Swap it with its set-aside [[Abandoned]] version.
back_text: Wymuszony - Jeśli w Ogrodach pałacu Bahia nie znajdują się żadni cywile: podmień je na ich odłożoną na bok wersję z cechą [[Opuszczona]].
back_flavor: Rozległy i bogaty pałac przyciąga wielu odwiedzających. Klejnotem posiadłości zaś jest ogród na dziedzińcu: oaza bujnej roślinności pośród surowej pustyni.

name: Marrakesh Railway Station
text: As an additional cost for you to move out of Marrakesh Railway Station, you must spend 1 resource. [action]: Resign. You run for your life. (Note: If there are no investigators in play, all remaining civilians in play will be slain.)
real_text: As an additional cost for you to move out of Marrakesh Railway Station, you must spend 1 resource. [action]: Resign. You run for your life. (Note: If there are no investigators in play, all remaining civilians in play will be slain.)
back_flavor: The once-bustling station is now quiet and lonely. The attendants in charge have delayed the train until tomorrow; news of what is happening in Marrakesh seems to have spread quickly.

name: Jemaa el-Fnaa Square
text: While you are at Jemaa el-Fnaa Square, increase the cost of each asset you play by 2.
real_text: While you are at Jemaa el-Fnaa Square, increase the cost of each asset you play by 2.
flavor: Stalls and tables are tipped over and merchandize is ruined. The entire square is devoid of both patrons and merchants. You won't be buying anything here anytime soon.
back_flavor: Wind whistles through the empty square, accompanied by the sound of slow footsteps and low groans of the risen.

name: Saadian's Tombs
text: Forced - When a non-[[Elite]] enemy enters Saadian's Tombs, before it engages any investigators: Heal all damage from it.
real_text: Forced - When a non-[[Elite]] enemy enters Saadian's Tombs, before it engages any investigators: Heal all damage from it.
flavor: Do the risen throngs still fear the tombs? Or do they merely resent death?
back_flavor: This once-holy place is now desecrated and overrun with figures that reek of death and fresh blood.

name: Tanneries
text: Each [[Risen]] enemy at Tanneries gets +1 fight and +1 evade.
real_text: Each [[Risen]] enemy at Tanneries gets +1 fight and +1 evade.
flavor: You watch the risen intentionally submerge themselves into pools of chemicals and swallow great mouthfuls of the foul liquid. Amaranth's power can only stave off decomposition so long. Perhaps this strange ritual preserves their rotting tissue.
back_flavor: For some reason, the risen dead have been especially active near the old tanneries. Why congregate here?

name: Bahia Palace Gardens
text: Forced - When you end your turn at Bahia Palace Gardens: Take 1 damage or 1 horror.
real_text: Forced - When you end your turn at Bahia Palace Gardens: Take 1 damage or 1 horror.
flavor: "Man selects only for his own good: Nature only for that of the being which she tends." -- Charles Darwin, The Origin of Species
back_flavor: The once-vibrant gardens are choked with black, thorned vines. The remaining trees are frail and flake under your touch, and the fountains run dry.

name: Save the Civilians
text: The civilians of Marrakesh are under attack! By getting them out of harm's way, you may be able to avert a massacre. (Note: Civilians still on locations are neither rescued nor slain.) [action] Spend 1 clue: Rescue a civilian from your location (place it on this card). Forced - When the game ends: flip this card (keep all tokens on it).
real_text: The civilians of Marrakesh are under attack! By getting them out of harm's way, you may be able to avert a massacre. (Note: Civilians still on locations are neither rescued nor slain.) flavor: A piercing howl resounds through the dusty streets, accompanied by the sound of feeding. Bystanders flee packs of the hungry dead as you traverse the city. All around you is the scent of rot and blood. Only you can save the people of this city from a terrible fate.

name: Amaranth
text: Hunter. Forced - When damage or horror from Amaranth's attack is assigned to an asset: Defeat that asset and Amaranth shifts each of her attached keys.
real_text: Hunter. Forced - When damage or horror from Amaranth's attack is assigned to an asset: Defeat that asset and Amaranth shifts each of her attached keys.
flavor: "Many say they would do anything for love. But I actually mean it."

name: The Scarlet Shadow
text: Objective – Expose the thief's whereabouts. If an investigator engages La Chica Roja, advance.
real_text: Objective – Expose the thief's whereabouts. If an investigator engages La Chica Roja, advance.
flavor: Thanks to Officer Bolívar, you believe you know which buildings might hold the pieces La Chica Roja is after. All that is left is to catch her in the act.
back_text:
If this is the first time this act has been advanced:
Following all of your leads, you manage to beat La Chica Roja to her target and lie in ambush. She arrives soon after and sets to work, but it's not long before she realizes something is wrong. She hums a jazzy improvisation and saunters around the room, scanning for something. "Come on out," she says at last, a smirk on her lips. You reveal yourself and tell her to stop what she is doing. "Or what?" she grins. "You gonna make me?"
Otherwise:
Once again, you beat your rival to the punch, and she spots you immediately. "You again?" she says dismissively. "Don't you have anything better to do? I'm quite busy, as you can see."

flavor: Scarlet light drowns the city. Somewhere, La Chica Roja's rival lies in wait, hoping to claim the final pieces of the Key for himself.
back_flavor:
It has taken much investigative work and even more toil, but you and your new ally have finally managed to confront the Coterie elder known only as The Sanguine Watcher. The spell protecting his body has faltered, and he is at your mercy. Heartless, empty eyes gaze back at you from behind his ruby spectacles. "I knew we never should have let you into our fold," he scolds the girl in red. "You are young and insolent. A jester who dons the clothes of a queen. A mockery of our great circle."
"You are the one who gives us a bad name," she barks back. "We are supposed to protect humanity, not torment it. If it were up to me, you would be driven out."
"We shall see." He pulls his ruby glasses down, revealing dark empty sockets where his eyes should be. Scarlet light bounces off the ominous rims resting on the tip of his nose. "Watch your step, girl. Not even your tricks can save you from me." Then, with a thrashing of dark, nightmarish wings, he is snatched from above and carried into the night.

real_text: Each non-weakness [[Cultist]] enemy gains concealed 1. Forced - After you evade a [[Cultist]] enemy, return it to the shadows and resolve its concealed keyword: Take control of 1 of its clues.
flavor: The cult operating in Istanbul is secretive and deadly, with eyes everywhere and ears in every dark corner of the city.
back_text: In player order, each investigator must choose: Either place 1 clue (from the token pool) on Clues Unveiled, or search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Cultist]] enemy and draw it (if no [[Cultist]] enemy is found, place 1 clue on Clues Unveiled, instead). Shuffle the encounter deck if it is searched. For each eclipse that was on the agenda when it advanced, an investigator must resolve the above effect an additional time. Flip this agenda back over, adding 1 resource to it, as an eclipse. (It keeps each other eclipse it had, as well.)
back_flavor: The daylight dims, and you strain your eyes to examine why. A strange, black shape has begun to crawl its way over the outline of the sun. An eclipse? Whatever the cult is up to, you better stop it soon...

name: Search for the Manuscript
text: Objective - Find the talisman before the cult does! If either the cult, or investigators at any location(s), possess the requisite number of clues as a group, advance. (Do not spend any clues when you advance.)
real_text: Objective - Find the talisman before the cult does! If either the cult, or investigators at any location(s), possess the requisite number of clues as a group, advance. (Do not spend any clues when you advance.)
flavor: According to Ms. Şahin, the talisman has been hidden somewhere in the city for many hundreds of years. You must not let it fall into the cult's hands!
back_text:
If the investigators reached the clue threshold first:
You discover what you believe to be the talisman's resting place and scramble to find the Key before your adversaries find you. But to your surprise, inside is only an ancient manuscript.
If the cult reached the clue threshold first:
You discover what you believe to be the talisman's resting place and find it already torn apart. Resting on the ground nearby is a torn-up manuscript, which you hastily begin to restore.
In either case: Resolve the concealed keyword on each non-weakness [[Cultist]] enemy not already in the shadows (as granted by agenda la). Shuffle the encounter discard pile and the set-aside Umbral Harbinger and Emissary from Yuggoth enemies into the encounter deck. Proceed to Act 2 Setup in the Campaign Guide.

name: Search for the Talisman
text: Objective - Find the talisman before the cult does! If either the cult, or investigators at the location designated as the east gate, possess the requisite number of clues as a group, advance. (Do not spend any clues when you advance.)
real_text: Objective - Find the talisman before the cult does! If either the cult, or investigators at the location designated as the east gate, possess the requisite number of clues as a group, advance. (Do not spend any clues when you advance.)
flavor: According to the manuscript, the talisman was discovered somewhat recently by a third party, and brought to the Grand Bazaar as a valuable item to be sold. You can't let that happen!
back_text:
If the investigators reached the clue threshold first, attach The Twisted Antiprism key to any investigator at the east gate.
If the cult reached the clue threshold first, attach The Twisted Antiprism key to the [[Cultist]] enemy with the most clues.
Reveal each concealed mini-card in play. For each enemy's mini-card, move that enemy from the shadows to that location. Remove each concealed mini-card from the game.
Put the locations from act 1 that were previously set aside back into play, with Hagia Sophia to the left of the entrance to the Grand Bazaar. These two locations are connected to one another for the rest of the scenario. Put Galata Docks into play.
If the cult reached the clue threshold first, for every 1 [per_investigator] more clues they had than the investigators, move the [[Cultist]] enemy with The Twisted Antiprism once toward Galata Docks.
Each investigator and [[Cultist]] enemy loses each of their clues. Flip The Unveiling story card over to its other side, removing all clues from it. Advance the act and agenda deck directly to "The Chase." It is both the current act and the current agenda.

back_flavor: In the dark light of an alien moon, your enemies work tirelessly to escape with the talisman in their possession.

Mijasz kilka ambasad, magazynów i obiektów handlowych prowadzonych przez firmy zarówno lokalne, jak i zagraniczne. Być może w jednym ze starszych budynków został niegdyś ukryty talizman. name: Uniwersytet Stambulski

real_text: [action]: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (6). If you succeed, take control of 1 clue on Clues Unveiled. (Max one success per game.)
back_flavor: Odbudowany niedawno uniwersytet mieści w sobie wydziały teologii, sztuki, matematyki i nauk ścisłych, a także kilka młodszych wydziałów, zaś jego prestiż podkreśla piękny kampus. Jeśli gdziekolwiek w mieście miałbyś znaleźć informacje dotyczące relikwii z jego przeszłości, to właśnie tutaj.

name: Hagia Sophia
text: Hagia Sophia dostaje +3 do wartości zasłony za każdy żeton nauki na niej. [action]: Umieść 1 [per_investigator] żetonów wskazówek (z puli żetonów) na Hagii Sophii. Umieść 1 żeton zasobu na Hagii Sophii (również z puli żetonów) jako żeton nauki.

back_flavor: Wielki Meczet Hagia Sophia, zbudowany pierwotnie jako katedra, jest jednym z najbardziej znanych budynków na całym świecie i uosobieniem architektury bizantyjskiej. To święte miejsce, które przetrwało liczne przemiany miasta na przestrzeni wieków, może zawierać wiele informacji związanych z twoim śledztwem, o ile wiesz, gdzie szukać.

name: Silence Speaks
text: Forced – If there are 5 [per_investigator] or more set-aside hollows: Choose and remove 3 [per_investigator] of them from the game and place 1 doom on this agenda. This effect may cause this agenda to advance.
real_text: Forced – If there are 5 [per_investigator] or more set-aside hollows: Choose and remove 3 [per_investigator] of them from the game and place 1 doom on this agenda. This effect may cause this agenda to advance.
flavor: A gentle patter of rain gives the moonless night a somber, moody ambience. Distant music and conversation drift on the wind, accompanied by a light drizzle.
back_text: The lead investigator must decide (choose one): - Search the encounter deck and discard pile for an enemy with the concealed keyword and draw it (resolving its concealed keyword). Shuffle the encounter deck. - Reveal the top card of each investigator's deck. Each investigator draws each weakness they revealed in this way. Set each other revealed card aside, out of play, as a hollow.
back_flavor: A flash of lightning draws your attention to the sky. Or, is it even lightning at all? Clouds and distorted space roll through the gloom of night. A shimmer. A blur. A blemish. And then one of the roiling clouds simply vanishes. Perhaps it was just your imagination. But something feels... strange. Is it possible the creatures you spotted in London could devour even the sky itself?

name: Easy Prey
text: Forced – If there are 4 [per_investigator] or more set-aside hollows: Choose and remove 2 [per_investigator] of them from the game and place 1 doom on this agenda. This effect may cause this agenda to advance.
real_text: Forced – If there are 4 [per_investigator] or more set-aside hollows: Choose and remove 2 [per_investigator] of them from the game and place 1 doom on this agenda. This effect may cause this agenda to advance.
flavor: Being hunted by the Coterie was bad enough; now you worry any random object you pass on the street, or even the sky itself, could simply swallow you whole, never to be seen or heard from again.
back_text: The lead investigator must decide (choose one): - Search the encounter deck and discard pile for an enemy with the concealed keyword and draw it (resolving its concealed keyword). Shuffle the encounter deck. - Reveal the top card of each investigator's deck. Each investigator draws each weakness they revealed in this way. Set each other revealed card aside, out of play, as a hollow.
back_flavor: As if possessed by a strange compulsion, your eyes continuously drift to the clouds obscuring the starless night sky. Every now and again, one cloud haunts your sight. The same cloud, every time. Its shape burns into your retina. Are you going mad? Your eyes trace around its outline. It cannot be the same. You saw the flash that caused that cloud to vanish. Didn't you?

name: A Betrayal of Eyes
text: Forced – If there are 3 [per_investigator] or more set-aside hollows: Choose and remove 1 [per_investigator] of them from the game and place 1 doom on this agenda. This effect may cause this agenda to advance.
real_text: Forced – If there are 3 [per_investigator] or more set-aside hollows: Choose and remove 1 [per_investigator] of them from the game and place 1 doom on this agenda. This effect may cause this agenda to advance.
flavor: The city is alive. Not alive in its usual sense - music and revelry and glamor - but truly, disturbingly alive. The streets shift under your feet, walls undulating as though breathing, windows glaring at you from afar. Sweat beads on your forehead. Is this all real? Or just paranoia?
back_text: Remove each hollow from the game. Gather each hollow that was removed from the game throughout this scenario. Each investigator finds their hollow with the highest experience cost and exiles it. In the Campaign Log, record erased from existence: and next to this, record the names of each unique card exiled in this way. For the rest of the campaign, players cannot include any copies of those cards (by title) in their decks (immediately remove any copies from each investigator's deck). (→R2) (page 31)
back_flavor:
You stop in your tracks, taking stock of your surroundings. The joyous noise of Havana has returned. A stillness has settled over the city. No more eyes in the shadows. No more familiar clouds. Stars twinkle above, mocking your suspicion with their charming beauty. Desi and his crew are nowhere to be found. And, worse...
There are sudden gaps in your memory.

name: False Step (v. I)
text: [action]: Resign. "The deal's off!" You leave Desi and his crew to their fate. Forced - If Desiderio Delgado Álvarez leaves play: Set him aside, out of play. Each investigator takes 1 horror.
real_text: [action]: Resign. "The deal's off!" You leave Desi and his crew to their fate. Forced - If Desiderio Delgado Álvarez leaves play: Set him aside, out of play. Each investigator takes 1 horror.
flavor: You and Desi are looking into the disappearances taking place in Havana. It has to be the work of the creatures you were investigating back in London. But they haven't been forgotten yet - maybe there is a way to bring them back?
back_text: If the Desiderio Delgado Álvarez story asset is in play, set him aside, out of play (removing all tokens and attachments from him). Find the set-aside Desiderio Delgado Álvarez enemy with the encounter card back. The lead investigator draws that enemy, resolving his concealed keyword. One at a time, in player order, each other investigator chooses a different set-aside [[Coterie]] enemy and draws it, resolving its concealed keyword. Shuffle the encounter discard pile and the remainder of the Crimson Conspiracy and Cleanup Crew encounter sets into the encounter deck.
back_flavor: "There's something off about all of this..." Desi remarks as you patrol the rainy streets of Havana. "I swear, I keep seeing something following us, but when I look-" Fate must have a sense of cosmic irony, as the moment Desi turns around, a formless shape not unlike a distortion in reality opens its gaping maw and swallows him whole. You shout his name in terror... but to your surprise, the distortion reshapes itself in his image. The imposter gives you a sinister grin before vanishing into the shadows, taking the real Desi with him.

name: False Colors (v. I)
text: [reaction] When an investigator would resolve an enemy's concealed X keyword, spend X clues, as a group: Spawn it engaged with that investigator instead. [action]: Resign. You leave Desi and his crew to their fate. Objective - If there are no enemies in the shadows, investigators may spend the requisite clues to advance.
real_text: [reaction] When an investigator would resolve an enemy's concealed X keyword, spend X clues, as a group: Spawn it engaged with that investigator instead. [action]: Resign. You leave Desi and his crew to their fate. Objective - If there are no enemies in the shadows, investigators may spend the requisite clues to advance.
flavor: Wait - what in the world just happened? That entity touched Desi and assumed his form. Is that what has been happening to Desi's crew? You have to find him before it finishes the job!
back_text: Ready the Desiderio Delgado Álvarez enemy, remove all tokens from him, and discard all attachments from him. Find the previously set-aside Desiderio Delgado Álvarez story asset, flip him to his enemy side, and spawn him at the same location as the one in play, randomizing them so you do not know which is which.
back_flavor:
It's clear now what has been happening to Desi's crew. They are being snatched by the very same entities you and Flint had been investigating and replaced by deadly imposters. But their true objective seems to be eliminating the evidence of their mimicry. Are they trying to infiltrate the Coterie from within? Are these creatures truly intelligent enough for such a scheme?
Whatever the case may be, you've tracked down the imposter. Desi is in danger of being erased from existence, or worse. You're not sure you can trust him, but you have to do something to help.

name: False Step (v. II)
text: Forced – At the end of the enemy phase: Deal X total damage to investigators at Café Luna, divided as they wish. X is the number of enemies in the shadows. [reaction] After a [[Coterie]] enemy takes any amount of damage: Discover half that many clues at Café Luna (rounded down).
real_text: Forced – At the end of the enemy phase: Deal X total damage to investigators at Café Luna, divided as they wish. X is the number of enemies in the shadows. [reaction] After a [[Coterie]] enemy takes any amount of damage: Discover half that many clues at Café Luna (rounded down).
flavor: Negotiations didn't go so well after all.
back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile and each set-aside [[Outsider]] enemy into the encounter deck.
If Desiderio Delgado Álvarez is not in the shadows, return him to the shadows and resolve his concealed keyword.
Put each set-aside [[Havana]] location into play.
Take each concealed mini-card in play, shuffle them, and randomly distribute them as evenly as possible among each location other than Café Luna.
back_flavor: With a bit of stealth, a bit of speed, and a lot of luck, you manage to make your way out the club's back entrance and into the streets of Havana. The gunfire continues for a few seconds, then ceases once your attackers realize you're no longer inside. Over the pounding of your heart in your chest, you listen closely for voices and hear Desi's, broken and uneven, on the other side of the building. "Find them — and when you do — end them," he orders. The sound of his voice grates against your mind. "They must not be allowed — to escape." Footsteps pound on the pavement as they split up in search of you.

name: False Colors (v. II)
text: [action] As a group, investigators at your location place clues they control on a [[Coterie]] enemy at your location equal to that enemy's remaining health: Parley. You gain some insight into the situation. Remove all doom from that enemy and automatically evade it. [action]: Resign. "I thought we had a deal!" You get out of the city while you still can. Objective – Discover why your contacts are after you. If there are 4 [per_investigator] total clues among enemies in play, advance.
real_text: [action] As a group, investigators at your location place clues they control on a [[Coterie]] enemy at your location equal to that enemy's remaining health: Parley. You gain some insight into the situation. Remove all doom from that enemy and automatically evade it. [action]: Resign. "I thought we had a deal!" You get out of the city while you still can. Objective – Discover why your contacts are after you. If there are 4 [per_investigator] total clues among enemies in play, advance.
flavor: Desi and his crew are pursuing and attacking you everywhere you go! But why?
back_text:
Reveal each concealed mini-card in play. For each enemy's mini-card, move that enemy from the shadows to that location. Then, remove each concealed mini-card from the game.
Ready the Desiderio Delgado Álvarez enemy, remove all tokens from him, and discard all attachments from him. Spawn the other set-aside Desiderio Delgado Álvarez enemy at the same location as the one in play, randomizing them so you do not know which is which.
Remove all clues from each enemy in play. For each clue removed from an enemy in this way, heal 1 damage from that enemy.
back_flavor: From your encounters with Desi's crew, you believe you've made a startling discovery. Their mannerisms don't appear to be their own, and their hostility is feral, alien. But it is the very slight distortion that occasionally follows in their wake that leads to your realization. The people who attacked you weren't Desi and his crew at all. They were taken by the entities you and Flint had been investigating and replaced by deadly imposters. But perhaps the real Desi is still out there, somewhere. If so, he's definitely in danger!

name: False Light
text: Each copy of Desiderio Delgado Álvarez loses concealed X, loses hunter, gains aloof, and gains the following ability: "[action]: Parley. Check the Campaign Log. If the cell knows Desi's past, you ask a question only he can answer. Look at the other side of this enemy." Objective – If either copy of Desiderio Delgado Álvarez is defeated, advance. (Do not look at its other side.)
real_text: Each copy of Desiderio Delgado Álvarez loses concealed X, loses hunter, gains aloof, and gains the following ability: "[action]: Parley. Check the Campaign Log. If the cell knows Desi's past, you ask a question only he can answer. Look at the other side of this enemy." Objective – If either copy of Desiderio Delgado Álvarez is defeated, advance. (Do not look at its other side.)
flavor: You arrive just in time to see two exact replicas of Desiderio embroiled in a deadly battle for the fate of his identity. In the midst of this chaos, it's impossible to tell which is which. There is no time to study their mannerisms. You have to act!
back_text: For the remainder of the campaign, do not look at the other sides of either copy of Desiderio Delgado Álvarez until you are instructed to do so. Find the copy of Desiderio Delgado Álvarez that is in play (if both copies are in the victory display, return one to play). Store this copy of Desiderio Delgado Álvarez in a safe place where you may refer to it later in the campaign. (→R1) (page 31)
back_flavor: Your intervention gives the Desi you suspect is real just enough time to gain the advantage. While you had been pulling your punches, Desi has no such qualms. He shoves his firearm in his imposter's stomach and pulls the trigger. The other Desi collapses, lifeless, to the floor. Blood pools from his bullet wound and soaks his body crimson. Desi spits on the corpse of the mimic. "Púdrete en el infierno," he mutters under his breath. Then he clasps your shoulder and gives you a grin. "Thanks. I really owe you one." From what you can tell, his mannerisms seem perfectly natural. You breathe a sigh of relief.

name: Café Luna
flavor: Bar Desiego oferuje szeroką gamę drinków i okazję posmakowania uciech nocnego życia zarówno dla mieszkańców, jak i turystów ze Stanów, którzy chcą uciec przed ograniczeniami prohibicji... A przynajmniej tak było, zanim on i jego zbrojni nie podziurawili tego miejsca na wylot. Co tu się u licha dzieje?

back_flavor: Szeroka droga biegnąca wzdłuż północnego falochronu Hawany to idealne miejsce zarówno na publiczne zgromadzenia, jak i potajemne spotkania. Czy Koteria mogła tam wysłać agentów?

name: Jardines de la Tropical

Wymuszony – Po tym, jak podczas badania Jardines de la Tropical twój test zakończy się porażką o 3 lub więcej: wybierz niebędącą osłabieniem kartę z twojej ręki i odłóż ją na bok, poza grę jako lukę.

back_flavor: Jeśli chodzi o wyższe sfery w Hawanie, nic nie jest bardziej kultowe niż to miejsce na świeżym powietrzu. Ale skoro to jedna z ulubionych miejscówek Desiego, to musi się tu dziać coś więcej.

name: Gran Teatro de La Habana
text: [fast] Podczas twojej tury wydaj 2 żetony zasobów: do końca twojej tury obniż o 2 wartość zasłony Gran Teatro de La Habana. (Limit raz na turę).
real_text: [fast] During your turn, spend 2 resources: Reduce Gran Teatro de La Habana's shroud by 2 until the end of your turn. (Limit once per turn.)
back_flavor: Wydaje się, że nikt inny nie zauważa obecności wirującej sfery nad Teatro Nacional, ale ty widziałeś ją już wcześniej, w Londynie. A tam, gdzie gnieżdżą się te stworzenia, z pewnością jest i Koteria. Może powinieneś kupić bilet na spektakl i sam się przekonać.

name: Miramar Yacht Club
text: [action]: Badanie. Zamiast odkrywać żetony wskazówek, podejrzyj odkrytą stronę utajonej małej karty w Miramar Yacht Club. Za każde 2 punkty, o które test zakończy się sukcesem, podejrzyj odkrytą stronę dodatkowej utajonej małej karty w Miramar Yacht Club.
real_text: [action]: Investigate. Instead of discovering clues, look at the revealed side of a concealed mini-card at Miramar Yacht Club. For every 2 points you succeed by, look at the revealed side of an additional concealed mini-card at Miramar Yacht Club.
flavor: Ekipa Desiego umie korzystać z uroków życia.
back_flavor:
Jeśli Desi jest członkiem klubu, są szanse, że to nie przypadek. Gdziekolwiek on i jego ekipa się pojawią, dzieją się dziwne rzeczy. A może jest na odwrót?
Jest tylko jeden sposób, aby się przekonać.

name: Hotel Plaza
text: [fast] Otrzymaj 1 punkt przerażenia: podejrzyj odkrytą stronę utajonej małej karty w Hotelu Plaza lub połączonej lokalizacji (bez ujawniania je). (Limit grupowy raz na rundę).
real_text: [fast] Take 1 horror: Look at the revealed side of a concealed mini-card at Plaza Hotel or at a connecting location (without exposing it). (Group limit once per round.)
back_flavor: Niedawno odnowiony, słynny Hotel Plaza oferuje wszystkie nowoczesne udogodnienia, a w swoich progach gościł już niejedną sławną osobę. Jednak przez ostatnie plotki o dziwnych cieniach i nieziemskich istotach grasujących nocą po korytarzach podejrzewasz, że po zmroku jest tu znacznie więcej atrakcji.

name: Lost and Forgotten
flavor: The prospector's journal described a horrifying predator. Some call the thing stalking the woods a beast, some call it a spirit, and others know it as a shapeshifter. Describing the thing seems to fill each witness with a primal, unspeakable terror.
back_text: Each investigator chooses an [[Ally]] or [[Item]] asset in their hand or play area and sets it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
back_flavor: The frigid landscape fills you with a kind of numbness. At first, you dismiss the feeling as purely physical, a side effect of the cold. It is only when you stop and consider the feeling itself that it dawns on you: the numbness is a result of some strange influence. You are forgetting small moments. Memories of the surrounding area. It is as though your mind itself is being hunted and fed upon.

name: Eyes of the Void
flavor: As you explore the region, you cannot shake the feeling that you are being watched. It as though a thousand eyes are staring directly at you... or perhaps through you. The surrounding forest is filled with a deafening silence.
back_text: Each investigator chooses an [[Ally]] or [[Item]] asset in their hand or play area and sets it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
back_flavor:
During your exploration, you stop and look up at the majestic vista of a nearby mountain range. One of the mountains appears strangely damaged, as though a great fist has punched a hole in the mountainside. Although it is covered in a layer of snow, there is something ominous about the deep, empty pit gouged into the side of the rock. You wonder what horrible thing burst out of the heart of the mountain.
As you stare at the impossible destruction around you, a faint buzzing in the back of your mind sets you on edge. You have a creeping feeling that you have forgotten something, or someone...

name: Annihilation
flavor: The landscape around you is being actively devoured, stolen from existence and memory. A feeling of numbness spreads through you as you stare at the fading wilderness. An uncanny sense that you are losing your grip on reality nags at the edge of your mind.
back_text: Remove each hollow from the game. Gather each hollow that was removed from the game throughout this scenario. Each investigator finds their hollow with the highest experience cost and exiles it. In the Campaign Log, record erased from existence: and next to this, record the names of each unique card exiled in this way. For the rest of the campaign, players cannot include any copies of those cards (by title) in their decks (immediately remove any copies from each investigator's deck). (→R4) (page 35)
back_flavor: Suddenly, a horde of blurred figures coalesces around you. An obscene numbness overtakes your senses as sight blurs and sense splinters. The numbness gives way to bliss as you slip under whatever awful influence has been changing this place. You struggle to hold onto reality, but your awareness drifts to unconsciousness, and you are dragged into a deep, forgetful slumber.

name: Quest for the Sable Glass
text: Objective – Only investigators at the Condemned Gold Mine may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
real_text: Objective – Only investigators at the Condemned Gold Mine may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: Thorne may have a head start in their search for the Sable Glass, but you have something they don't: Rhett Landry's journal. If you can reach the prospector's gold mine before the Coterie, you may be able to keep the Key out of their hands.
back_text:
If it is agenda 1:
Ignoring signs warning that the mine is condemned and dangerous, you trace a path to the branch Landry wrote about in his journal and find the Sable Glass buried in the rock. When you emerge, however, you are not alone.
If it is agenda 2 or 3:
As you approach the condemned mine, you see from the broken barricades and tracks in the snow that Thorne and the Coterie have already arrived. Before you can backtrack, two guards emerge from the shadows brandishing shotguns. "Don't move," one of them says.
In either case: Read Scenario Interlude: Raw Deal in the Campaign Guide.

name: Brewing Catastrophe (v. I)
text: Each enemy loses hunter and gains patrol (nearest location with a Key Locus). While there are no other Key Locuses in play, The Claret Knight counts as a Key Locus for the purpose of card abilities. When checking the doom threshold, doom on cards other than this agenda subtract from the total doom in play instead of adding to it. Objective - Defend the Knight! If The Claret Knight is defeated, advance this agenda.
real_text: Each enemy loses hunter and gains patrol (nearest location with a Key Locus). While there are no other Key Locuses in play, The Claret Knight counts as a Key Locus for the purpose of card abilities. When checking the doom threshold, doom on cards other than this agenda subtract from the total doom in play instead of adding to it. Objective - Defend the Knight! If The Claret Knight is defeated, advance this agenda.
flavor: The Beast is coming to claim its due...
back_text:
If this agenda advanced by reaching its doom threshold:
The storm rages on. Doors batter and foundations shake. The Key Locuses dim. You've stood your ground for as long as you can. Weary and terrified that you have chosen an impossible course, you and your unlikely Coterie allies retreat to the Claret Knight's office as a last line of defense. The mood is tense and quiet. Any moment you suspect the Beast or its devotees will tear down the door and turn this chamber into a bloodbath...
Advance the act.
If The Claret Knight was defeated:
The storm rages on. Doors batter and foundations shake. The Key Locuses have failed. You've stood your ground for as long as you could. Weary and terrified that you have chosen an impossible course, you are forced to lay low for a moment to lick your wounds. That is when the Beast strikes...
(→R3) (page 42)

name: Brewing Catastrophe (v. II)
text: While there are no other Key Locuses in play, The Bourse counts as a Key Locus for the purpose of card abilities.
real_text: While there are no other Key Locuses in play, The Bourse counts as a Key Locus for the purpose of card abilities.
flavor: You've refused the offer of the Coterie agent who appears to control things in Alexandria, and instead teamed up with a local Foundation operative, Hossam Sirry, who hopes to see the Coterie ousted from the city. With any luck, you can claim the Key here for yourself as well, killing two birds with one stone.
back_text:
The investigators must decide (choose one):
- Each surviving investigator immediately takes 1 direct damage and suffers 1 physical trauma. Flip this agenda back over and place 10 doom on it.
- Each surviving investigator immediately resigns.
back_flavor: The storm rages on. Doors batter and foundations shake. You have tried your damnedest, but the Claret Knight - and thus the last of the Key Locuses preventing you from acquiring your prize - still stands. With the supernatural storm growing more and more potent, and the rest of the Coterie mobilizing for all-out war with one another, you don't think you'll get another chance like this. Perhaps it would be better to retreat and lay low.

name: Brewing Catastrophe (v. III)
text: While there are no other Key Locuses in play, Catacombs of Kom el Shoqafa counts as a Key Locus for the purpose of card abilities.
real_text: While there are no other Key Locuses in play, Catacombs of Kom el Shoqafa counts as a Key Locus for the purpose of card abilities.
flavor: In your pursuit of Alexandria's Key, you are on the trail of the Beast in a Cowl of Crimson, a Coterie member so dangerous and chaotic, even the rest of the Coterie fears its wrath. Its bloody rampage has sent the entire city into a state of terror.
back_text:
The investigators must decide (choose one):
- Each surviving investigator immediately takes 1 direct damage and suffers 1 physical trauma. Flip this agenda back over and place 10 doom on it.
- Each surviving investigator immediately resigns.
back_flavor: The storm rages on. Doors batter and foundations shake. You have tried your damnedest, but the Beast in a Cowl of Crimson is too dangerous and too agile to pin down. So long as its lair remains undisturbed - and thus the last of the Key Locuses still standing - you cannot reclaim the creature's Key. With teh supernatural storm growing more and more potent and the Beast's devotees growing bolder and stronger by the hour, you don't think you'll get another chance like this. Perhaps it would be beter to retreat and lay low.

name: Rabbits Who Run (v. I)
text: During the "enemies attack" step of the enemy phase, in addition to their standard attacks, each ready enemy attacks each Key Locus at its location as if it were an engaged investigator. Horror dealt by these attacks is dealt as damage, instead. Objective - Defend the Key and hold out for as long as you can. (The agenda represents how long you must defend it. You will be instructed when to advance.)
real_text: During the "enemies attack" step of the enemy phase, in addition to their standard attacks, each ready enemy attacks each Key Locus at its location as if it were an engaged investigator. Horror dealt by these attacks is dealt as damage, instead. Objective - Defend the Key and hold out for as long as you can. (The agenda represents how long you must defend it. You will be instructed when to advance.)
flavor: You've agreed to help The Claret Knight and his enforcers defend his Key from another member of the Coterie - the Beast in a Cowl of Crimson.
back_text: Add The Beast in a Cowl of Crimson to the victory display. Add each Key Locus in play to the victory display. (→R1) (page 42)
back_flavor: ...But when the storm passes, you still stand, and the Light of Pharos is safe. Your host orders several of his agents to track down the Beast's whereabouts, and you are surprised to find that it has fled the city. "We're safe," one of them says, letting out a held breath. "We're finally safe."

name: Rabbits Who Run (v. II)
text: Objective - If The Claret Knight is defeated, or if an investigator controls The Light of Pharos, advance.
real_text: Objective - If The Claret Knight is defeated, or if an investigator controls The Light of Pharos, advance.
flavor:
"The Bourse is their base of operations," Agent Sirry summarizes what you know before you put your plan into action. "If we're going to confront the Coterie, we have to first destroy the Key Locuses scattered around the city. Otherwise, we don't stand a chance."
You nod, recalling what the Claret Knight told you earlier. If you can find and destroy these locuses, you can enter The Bourse once more.
back_text:
If the investigators took control of the Light of Pharos:
You safely enter the office where you met with the Coterie earlier and crack open the vault. The light inside shines on undisturbed. You snatch the Key from its resting place and abscond before the rest of the knight's enforcers catch up to you.
(→R2) (page 42) If the investigators defeated The Claret Knight:
"Fools," the knight utters, clutching his side. "Do you not understand? We are the last guardians of humanity. Without us..." Cutting him off, several of his bodyguards suddenly rushing into the chamber, but they are too late to stop you. Rather than confront you, they pull their leader to safety. "You will pay for this," the elderly man shouts through a barrage of coughs as he is escorted off the premises. "We will pay for this."
(→R2) (page 42)

name: Rabbits Who Run (v. III)
text: Objective - If The Beast in a Cowl of Crimson is defeated, or if an investigator controls The Light of Pharos, advance.
real_text: Objective - If The Beast in a Cowl of Crimson is defeated, or if an investigator controls The Light of Pharos, advance.
flavor: Somewhere in the city, the Beast dwells in its lair, sending its devotees to the streets to spill blood and kidnap victims to feast upon. If you are to stop this bloodbath, you'll have to first destroy the Key Locuses scattered around the city which protect the Beast's lair. Only then can you retrieve the Key it has stolen and drive the Beast from Alexandria.
back_text:
If the investigators took control of the Light of Pharos:
You sneak carefully through the catacombs, searching for the place where the Beast has hidden the Light of Pharos. Eventually, you find a hidden passage leading to a tomb much deeper beneath the city. Inside, a telltale glow emanates from the cracks of an ancient sarcophagus. You push off the stone lid and claim the Key from within, fleeing before the Beast realizes what you have done.
If the investigators defeated the Beast in a Cowl of Crimson:
The Beast lets out a sinister growl and retreats, leaving a trail of ichorous blood in its wake. You could pursue it, but your prize lies deeper in the catacombs, and besides, you worry how dangerous such a creature might become when cornered...
In either case: Check the Campaign Log: - If the cell made a deal with the Claret Knight, (→R5) (page 43) - If the cell is assisting Agent Sirry, (→R6) (page 43)

name: Giełda Papierów Wartościowych
text:
Wrogowie nie mogą wejść do Giełdy Papierów Wartościowych, chyba że Rubinowy Rycerz jest jedyną Kluczową pieczęcią w grze (jeśli wróg miałby zostać tu rozstawiony, zamiast tego rozstaw go w połączonej lokalizacji).
[action] Badacze w Giełdzie Papierów Wartościowych wydają, jako grupa, 1[per_investigator] żetonów wskazówek: usuń 1 żeton zagłady z dowolnej lokalizacji lub z kontrolowanego przez ciebie atutu. Dowolny gracz może aktywować tę zdolność.
real_text:
Unless The Claret Knight is the only Key Locus in play, enemies cannot enter The Bourse (if an enemy would spawn here, spawn it at a connecting location instead).
[action] Investigators at The Bourse spend 1[per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remove 1 doom from any location or from an asset you control. Any player may trigger this ability.
back_text: Wejście do biur jest zabezpieczone. Wrogowie nie mogą wejść do Giełdy Papierów Wartościowych, chyba że Rubinowy Rycerz jest jedyną Kluczową pieczęcią w grze (jeśli wróg miałby zostać tu rozstawiony, zamiast tego rozstaw go w połączonej lokalizacji).
back_flavor: Wygląda na to, że budynek giełdy w Aleksandrii jest czymś więcej niż tylko placówką finansową - to także miejsce ukrycia przez Rubinowego Rycerza Klucza, którego szukasz.

name: Giełda Papierów Wartościowych
text: [action]: Wykonaj test [willpower] lub [agility] (4). Jeśli test zakończy się sukcesem, badacze w tej lokalizacji mogą wydać, jako grupa, 1 [per_investigator] żetonów wskazówek, aby umieścić 1 żeton zasobu na Świetle Faros. Następnie, jeśli na Świetle Faros znajdują się 3 żetony zasobów, wybierz badacza w tej lokalizacji, który przejmie nad nim kontrolę.
real_text: [action]: Test [willpower] or [agility] (4). If you succeed, investigators at this location may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues as a group, to place 1 resource on the Light of Pharos. Then, if there are 3 resources on the Light of Pharos, choose an investigator at this location to take control of it.
back_text: Wejście do biur jest strzeżone. Nie możesz wejść do Giełdy Papierów Wartościowych, chyba że jest jedyną Kluczową pieczęcią w grze.
back_flavor: Wygląda na to, że Koteria założyła swoją siedzibę w budynku giełdy Aleksandrii. Najciemniej zawsze pod latarnią?

name: Giełda Papierów Wartościowych
text: [action]: Badanie. Jeśli test zakończy się sukcesem, zamiast odkrywać żetony wskazówek zyskaj 4 żetony zasobów. Możesz obniżyć trudność tego testu o 2. Jeśli to zrobisz, zyskaj 2 żetony zasobów mniej, jeśli test zakończy się sukcesem. (Limit grupowy raz na rundę).
real_text: [action]: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, gain 4 resources. You may reduce the difficulty of this test by 2. If you do, gain 2 fewer resources if you succeed. (Group limit once per round.)
back_flavor: Giełda Papierów Wartościowych w Aleksandrii to miejsce, które spaja miasto jako główny ośrodek gospodarczy Egiptu. Przez cały dzień giełda tętni życiem, w pobliżu zaparkowanych jest wiele powozów i samochodów, a dziesiątki osób przekraczają bramy tego wyjątkowego budynku.

name: Hotel Windsor Palace
text:
Dopóki znajdujesz się w Hotelu Windsor Palace...
- ...jeśli jest tu Kluczowa pieczęć, podnieś o 1 koszt każdego atutu z cechą [[Przedmiot]] lub [[Sprzymierzeniec]], który zagrywasz.
- ...jeśli nie ma tu Kluczowej pieczęci, obniż o 1 koszt każdego atutu z cechą [[Przedmiot]] lub [[Sprzymierzeniec]], który zagrywasz.
real_text:
While you are at Windsor Palace Hotel...
- ...if there is a Key Locus here, increase the cost of each [[Item]] or [[Ally]] asset you play by 1.
- ...if there is no Key Locus here, reduce the cost of each [[Item]] or [[Ally]] asset you play by 1.
back_flavor: Wznoszący się nad wybrzeżem Windsor Palace jest jednym z najlepszych hoteli w mieście, goszczącym samą elitę. Jeśli wysłannicy Koterii mieliby się gdzieś ukrywać, to właśnie tu. Według twoich informacji jest to również miejsce ukrycia jednej z „pieczęci” Rubinowego Rycerza.

name: Victoria College
text: [reaction] Kiedy miałbyś dobrać dokładnie 1 kartę z twojej talii, dopóki znajdujesz się w Victoria College: zamiast tego podejrzyj 2 wierzchnie karty z twojej talii, wybierz 1 z nich, którą dobierasz, a drugą wtasuj z powrotem do twojej talii. (Limit raz na rundę).
real_text: [reaction] When you would draw exactly 1 card from your deck while you are at Victoria College: Instead, look at the top 2 cards of your deck, choose 1 to draw, and shuffle the other back into your deck. (Limit once per round.)
back_flavor: Założona zaledwie dwie dekady temu uczelnia jest domem dla wielu ważnych i zamożnych studentów. Twoje informacje wskazują, że jedna z pieczęci Rubinowego Rycerza została niedawno przeniesiona - wcale byś się nie zdziwił, gdyby teraz znajdowała się właśnie tu.

name: Cytadela Qaitbay
text: Wymuszony - Po tym, jak twój test umiejętności podczas badania Cytadeli Qaitbay zakończy się porażką: do końca rundy nie możesz odkrywać żetonów wskazówek ani ujawniać utajonych małych kart w Cytadeli Qaitbay.
real_text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Qaitbay Citadel: You cannot discover clues or expose concealed mini-cards at Qaitbay Citadel for the remainder of the round.
back_flavor: Cytadela Qaitbay, jedna z najważniejszych historycznych twierdz nad Morzem Śródziemnym, została wybudowana na miejscu słynnej starożytnej latarni morskiej w Aleksandrii.

name: Corniche
text: Wymuszony - Po tym, jak Corniche zostanie z sukcesem zbadane: podnieś o 2 trudność każdego innego testu wykonywanego w Corniche w tej rundzie.
real_text: Forced - After The Corniche is successfully investigated: Increase the difficulty of each other test performed at The Corniche this round by 2.
back_flavor: Fale uderzają o biegnącą wzdłuż wybrzeża Aleksandrii drogę, zalewając całą okolicę. W Corniche, swoistym centrum aktywności, wiele ulic przecina się z wzdłuż tej długiej trasy - być może to idealne miejsce do ukrycia kluczowej pieczęci?

name: Zen'et el Settat
text: Wymuszony - Kiedy walczysz z wrogiem, znajdując się na Zan'et el Settat: musisz wydać 1 akcję albo do tego ataku podnieś wartość walki danego wroga o 2.
real_text: Forced - When you fight an enemy while at Zen'et el Settat: You must either spend 1 action or increase that enemy's fight by 2 for this attack.
back_flavor: Ten ruchliwy, zatłoczony rynek słynie z krętych uliczek, tętniących życiem sklepów i makabrycznej przeszłości. Przemierzając alejki, omiatasz wzrokiem wszystkie zaułki w poszukiwaniu ukrytej tutaj kluczowej pieczęci.

name: Katakumby Kaum asz-Szukaf
text: [action]: Wykonaj test [willpower] lub [agility] (4). Jeśli test zakończy się sukcesem, badacze w tej lokalizacji mogą wydać, jako grupa, 1 [per_investigator] żetonów wskazówek, aby umieścić 1 żeton zasobu na Świetle Faros. Następnie, jeśli na Świetle Faros znajdują się 3 żetony zasobów, wybierz badacza w tej lokalizacji, który przejmie nad nim kontrolę.
real_text: [action]: Test [willpower] or [agility] (4). If you succeed, investigators at this location may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to place 1 resource on the Light of Pharos. back_text: Wejście do katakumb jest ukryte. Nie możesz wejść do Katakumb Kaum asz-Szukaf, chyba że jest to jedyna Kluczowa pieczęć w grze.
back_flavor: Nekropolia jest miejscem spoczynku kilku wybitnych zmarłych, ale także kryjówką czegoś znacznie bardziej przerażającego.

name: Katakumby Kaum asz-Szukaf
text: [action]: Wykonaj test [willpower] (6). Jeśli test zakończy się sukcesem, automatycznie wymknij się Bestii w karmazynowym kapturze (niezależnie od jej obecnej lokalizacji). (Limit grupowy raz na grę.)
real_text: [action]: Test [willpower] (6). If you succeed, automatically evade The Beast in a Cowl of Crimson (regardless of its current location). (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: Wnętrze nekropolii pokryte jest wypalonymi śladami i smugami zaschniętej krwi. Co się tu do diabła wydarzyło...?
back_text: Wejście do katakumb jest zablokowane. Nie możesz wejść do Katakumb Kaum asz-Szukaf. Bestia w karmazynowym kapturze nie może opuścić Katakumb Kaum asz-Szukaf. Wymuszony - Jeśli na obecnej tajemnicy znajduje się 6 lub więcej żetonów zagłady: odkryj Katakumby Kaum asz-Szukaf.

name: Katakumby Kaum asz-Szukaf
text: [action]: Badanie. Jeśli test zakończy się sukcesem, zamiast odkrywać żetony wskazówek dobierz 3 karty. Możesz obniżyć trudność tego testu o 2. Jeśli to zrobisz, dobierz 1 kartę mniej, jeśli test zakończy się sukcesem. (Limit grupowy raz na rundę).
real_text: [action]: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, draw 3 cards. You may reduce the difficulty of this test by 2. If you do, draw 1 fewer card if you succeed. (Group limit once per round.)
back_flavor: Kaum asz-Szukaf - co oznacza Kopiec Odłamków – jest miejscem wielu grobowców, posągów i innych starożytnych relikwii, łączących wpływy egipskie, rzymskie i greckie. Obecnie jest częściowo zalany i zamknięty dla zwiedzających. Kto wie, jakie inne tajemnice kryją się w środku?

[cultist]: -4. Jeśli test zakończy się porażką o 2 lub więcej, umieść 1 ładunek na Żniwiarzu cieni.

name: Painful History
flavor: The city buzzes with spiritual activity. Empty halls resound with footsteps, phantom knocks, voiceless whispers. Some deep pain in this city longs to be known. A wordless dread fills the silence and pervades every moment.
back_text: Each investigator loses all of their clues. The lead investigator must decide (choose one): - Discard the [[Ally]] asset in play with the highest printed cost. Test [willpower] (X), where X is that asset's printed cost. If you fail, place charges on The Shade Reaper equal to the discarded asset's printed cost. - Place 1 doom on Tzu San Niang. If it is act 1, advance the act (to act 1b).
back_flavor: Amidst the throng of a busy street, you see the woman with the red parasol flit past a food stall down a narrow back alley. Following her, you step into an alley filled with a hazy, silvery light. A strange feeling comes over you, and your head swims with alien whispers.

name: Restless Dead
text: If there is only one investigator in the game, this agenda gets +1 doom threshold. Forced - When you engage Tzu San Niang: Investigators at your location must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group. If they cannot, draw the top card of the encounter deck instead. (Hint: When this agenda advances, Tzu San Niang will harvest a nearby spirit if her location is unknown!)
real_text: If there is only one investigator in the game, this agenda gets +1 doom threshold. Forced - When you engage Tzu San Niang: Investigators at your location must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group. If they cannot, draw the top card of the encounter deck instead. (Hint: When this agenda advances, Tzu San Niang will harvest a nearby spirit if her location is unknown!)
flavor: The sense that you are not alone grows, and the spirits' wordless screams fill your mind. An oily fog rolls in to choke the streets of Kuala Lumpur in a ghostly aura.
back_text:
If Tzu San Niang is in play at any location: Tzu San Niang attacks each investigator at her location. Return her to the shadows and resolve her concealed keyword, distributing each of those concealed mini-cards as evenly as possible among each location with a non-weakness [[Geist]] enemy. Flip this card back to agenda 2a.
If Tzu San Niang is in the shadows: Reveal all concealed mini-cards in play and set each decoy aside, out of play. Swap the Tzu San Niang enemy with her concealed mini-card. Place each non-weakness [[Geist]] enemy at her location facedown beneath her, then place 4 charges on The Shade Reaper. If there are no non-weakness [[Geist]] enemies in play, advance the act to act 2b. Otherwise, return Tzu San Niang to the shadows and resolve her concealed keyword, distributing each of those concealed mini-cards as evenly as possible among each location with a non-weakness [[Geist]] enemy. Flip this card back to agenda 2a.

name: Fear The Reaper
text: Each [[Geist]] enemy gain hunter and retaliate and cannot be flipped over. Forced - When doom is placed on this agenda: Remove 1 [[Geist]] enemy from beneath Tzu San Niang and spawn it faceup at her location.
real_text: Each [[Geist]] enemy gain hunter and retaliate and cannot be flipped over. Forced - When doom is placed on this agenda: Remove 1 [[Geist]] enemy from beneath Tzu San Niang and spawn it faceup at her location.
flavor: Tzu San Niang smiles sweetly as she bears down on you. Behind her, a massive shadow moves of its own accord, writhing in fulminant patterns on the wall. "This will be quick," she coos.
back_text: Each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma. (→R3)
back_flavor: Tzu San Niang corners you in a narrow alley, her face heavily shadowed in the harsh evening light. "Don't be afraid," her voice worms its way into your mind. "I do not wish you hard. Quite the opposite, I think we should be friends." She grins and snaps her parasol shut, pointing it directly at you. "Well, 'friend' is a little too kind. You're my new <u>pet</u>." The tip dances with crackling, silvery light, and a torrent of energy tears through the air toward you. As waves of pain wash over you, you fall to your knees, wracked with agony. Tzu San Niang laughs as you lose consciousness.

name: The Lady with the Red Parasol
real_name: The Lady with the Red Parasol
text: Objective – Find Tzu San Niang before the agenda advances. When you engage Tzu San Niang, investigators must spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance. If they cannot, return her to the shadows and resolve her concealed keyword.
real_text: Objective – Find Tzu San Niang before the agenda advances. When you engage Tzu San Niang, investigators must spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance. If they cannot, return her to the shadows and resolve her concealed keyword.
flavor: The figure holding a red parasol melts into the bustle of the city, but is she aware of your presence? If you can track her to her destination, you may better understand her aims in Kuala Lumpur.
back_text: Put the set-aside Melati's Shop location into play and reveal it. Disengage each investigator from each enemy engaged with them and move each investigator to Melati's Shop. Read Scenario Interlude: The Bomoh (page 47).
back_flavor: After what feels like hours of searching, you catch the trail of the Lady with the Red Parasol. You follow her down a narrow side-street to the worn façade of an old shop, which she steps inside. Uncertain of the risk she might pose, you wait for her to emerge rather than follow her into a potential trap. However, after some time passes, you grow impatient and step into the shop.

name: Ghost Light
text: [[Geist]] enemies cannot leave [[Haunted]] locations. Objective – Quell the restless spirits before they are consumed by Tzu San Niang! At the end of the round, if there are no non-weakness [[Geist]] enemies in play, advance.
real_text: [[Geist]] enemies cannot leave [[Haunted]] locations. Objective – Quell the restless spirits before they are consumed by Tzu San Niang! At the end of the round, if there are no non-weakness [[Geist]] enemies in play, advance.
flavor: Melati spoke of the great suffering Tzu San Niang has brought to this city. Perhaps by entreating the spirits and laying them to rest, you can stop her from reaping the pain she has sown.
back_text:
If there are no enemies facedown beneath Tzu San Niang:
A petite figure emerges from the yellow haze. Tzu San Niang points at you accusingly. "How dare you! You have no right to interfere with my work," she seethes. The parasol in her hand glows with strange energy.
Reveal all concealed mini-cards and remove them from the game. Flip Tzu San Niang to her (Out for Blood) side and spawn her at the location where her mini-card was. Advance the agenda directly to agenda 3a (do not resolve agenda 2b).
If there is at least 1 enemy facedown beneath Tzu San Niang:
A petite figure emerges from the yellow haze. Tzu San Niang smirks as she twirls her parasol overhead. "What is it? You're still thirsty?" she coos, speaking to something you can't see. "They're ready to harvest." The parasol in her hand glows with strange energy.
The lead investigator exposes all concealed mini-cards. Flip Tzu San Niang to her (Out for Blood) side and heal all damage from her. She engages the lead investigator. Advance the agenda directly to agenda 3a (do not resolve agenda 2b).

name: Harvester of Woe
text: [reaction] When you are dealt damage and/or horror from Tzu San Niang's forced effect, investigators at your location may spend any number of clues: Cancel that much damage/horror. Objective – If Tzu San Niang is defeated, advance.
real_text: [reaction] When you are dealt damage and/or horror from Tzu San Niang's forced effect, investigators at your location may spend any number of clues: Cancel that much damage/horror. Objective – If Tzu San Niang is defeated, advance.
flavor: The Lady with the Red Parasol has shifted her attention to you. She sings a haunting song as she stalks through the streets. Under any other circumstance, you might find the melody beautiful.
back_text: The investigators must decide (choose one): - Use the parasol against her. (→R1) - Let her go. (→R2)
back_flavor:
As Tzu San Niang fires another eldritch beam of crackling light at you, you charge forward, ignoring the pain, and wrest the parasol from her grip. She fights back with all the fury of a cornered animal. Countless souls, all bound in torment to the Key, cry out at once. The woman lets out an ear-piercing scream as the red parasol is wrenched away from her. You step back, brandishing her own weapon.
"A hollow victory," she says haughtily. "I know you don't have the nerve to use my shade against me." She turns to walk away.

name: Kuala Lumpur Station
text: [fast] During your turn, pay 2 resources: Move (to a connecting location). (Limit once per turn.) [action] Discard an asset you control from play: Gain resources equal to half the discarded asset's printed cost, rounded down, and remember that you "traded for a kitten." (Group limit once per game.)
real_text: [fast] During your turn, pay 2 resources: Move (to a connecting location). (Limit once per turn.) [action] Discard an asset you control from play: Gain resources equal to half the discarded asset's printed cost, rounded down, and remember that you "traded for a kitten." (Group limit once per game.)
back_flavor: This busy railway stop brings in travelers from all over the world, near and far. The recently completed platform now connects Kuala Lumpur to Singapore and Siam.

name: Kuala Lumpur Station
text: [action]: Resign. "There's nothing more we can do here." You hastily book passage out of the city. [action] Investigators at this location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Heal 2 horror. Remember that you "found a cheap memento."

back_flavor: The western wing of the station is veiled in a heavy fog. Glimmering shapes flit to and fro in the haze.

name: Selangor Club
text: Each investigator at Selangor Club does not collect resources during the upkeep phase. [action] Spend 2 resources: Parley. You enjoy a pleasant meal and drinks. Heal 1 damage and 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location. (Limit once per round.)
real_text: Each investigator at Selangor Club does not collect resources during the upkeep phase. [action] Spend 2 resources: Parley. You enjoy a pleasant meal and drinks. Heal 1 damage and 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location. (Limit once per round.)
back_flavor: The Selangor Club attracts all the city's wealthiest clientele, but especially caters to the British imperialists that run much of the export business.

name: Selangor Club Padang
text: [action]: Parley. Test [combat] (4) to join the games. If you fail, remember that you "embarrassed the consulate." If you succeed, gain 3 resources. (Max one success per round.)
real_text: [action]: Parley. Test [combat] (4) to join the games. If you fail, remember that you "embarrassed the consulate." If you succeed, gain 3 resources. (Max one success per round.)
flavor: The tight-lipped expatriates become much more trusting once you help their team achieve victory.
back_flavor: The large padang, or square, is a well-manicured lawn used for all sorts of sporting events, from cricket to rugby. Spectators watch the games from either side of the square or from inside the clubhouse.

name: Melati's Shop
text: [action] Investigators at Melati's Shop spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that you "peered beyond." Look at the revealed side of a concealed mini-card or the other side of a [[Geist]] enemy in play.
real_text: [action] Investigators at Melati's Shop spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that you "peered beyond." Look at the revealed side of a concealed mini-card or the other side of a [[Geist]] enemy in play.
flavor: "When I quiet my mind, I can hear them clearly."
back_flavor: The bomoh's shop is primarily an apothecary, with shelf after shelf filled with dried bundles of herbs and flowers, some ground up in little jars or in alcohol tinctures. Other supplies for the bomoh's practice rest on a bookshelf behind the counter: lime, resin, and a dagger in a wooden sheath.

name: Wayang Kulit Theater
text:
X is equal to half the charges on The Shade Reaper, rounded up (to a max of 8).
[action] Investigators at Wayang Kulit Theater spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Heal 2 damage. Remember that you "shared a deep pain."
real_text:
X is equal to half the charges on The Shade Reaper, rounded up (to a max of 8).
[action] Investigators at Wayang Kulit Theater spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Heal 2 damage. Remember that you "shared a deep pain."
back_flavor: The elaborate shadow puppet shows that take place on stage make this theater a popular attraction. The distinctive puppets are made to cast stylized silhouettes on a backlit screen. The effect gives the impression that the screen is a veil between reality and some shadowy other world.

name: Tin Mine
text: [action]: Test [agility] (6). Investigators at Tin Mine may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to automatically succeed. If you succeed, draw 2 cards and remember that you "found hidden bones." (Group limit once per game.) Forced - After you fail a skill test while at Tin Mine: Take 1 damage.

back_flavor: Large pits yawn like open mouths in the earth: some are filled with rainwater, some flicker like shuttering eyes in the low light. The supports that hold up the rickety scaffolding that spans the pits are temporary, at best.

linked_card.name: Playful Shadows
linked_card.text:
If an investigator has "embarrassed the consulate," read the following (otherwise, flip this card back to its enemy side, heal all damage from it, disengage it from all investigators, and exhaust it):

The sound of laughter turns to weeping, then turns back to laughter. "It is the spirit of a boy," Melati tells you. A round ball rolls out from the darkness to your feet as you look up at the trembling forms. "The padang where he once played is now the ground of one of Ms. Tzu's endeavors. Your small gesture amused him. I think he will be at peace now."

Add this card to the victory display.

linked_card.name: Timorous Shadows
linked_card.text:
If an investigator has "peered beyond," read the following (otherwise, flip this card back to its enemy side, heal all damage from it, disengage it from all investigators, and exhaust it):

"It is the spirit of a girl. She watched many stories unfold in this very theater," says Melati. The shadow on the screen forms a hungry smile filled with sharp teeth that turns to a fearful frown. "She is loathe to let go of this place, for she does not know if her story will continue." As Melati translates, you assure the spirit that you have looked beyond the veil and she can leave this plane of existence. As the hoary shadows dissipate, you feel a coldness as you reflect on what you saw - and didn't see - in the beyond. Was it wrong to reassure her?

Add this card to the victory display.

linked_card.name: A Lost Memento
linked_card.text:
If an investigator has "found a cheap memento," read the following (otherwise, flip this card back to its enemy side, heal all damage from it, disengage it from all investigators, and exhaust it):

"These are the spirits of fallen miners," says Melati, holding onto the flimsy tin figurine you found. "This belonged to one of them. It is sculpted from tin from this very mine. Tzu San Niang's heartless business separated the workers from their families. And now, they will never be reunited, except in death."

She holds the tin figurine over the surface of the water and lets go of it. You think you can see the outline of wispy, spectral hands grasping at it as it sinks to the bottom of the pit.

Add this card to the victory display.
