name: The House Always Watches
text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Each investigator who is at the same location as a ready [[Casino]] enemy raises their alarm level by 1. Forced - After an investigator defeats a [[Casino]] enemy: Raise that investigator's alarm level by 1.
real_text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Each investigator who is at the same location as a ready [[Casino]] enemy raises their alarm level by 1. Forced - After an investigator defeats a [[Casino]] enemy: Raise that investigator's alarm level by 1.
flavor: You have arrived at Défis de la Roulette. If you are to recover the Wellspring, you must learn all that you can about this casino and the cult that operates it.
back_text: If the investigators, as a group, possess 10 [per_investigator] or more resources, remember that you "cleaned out the house." (→R1)
back_flavor: The stray glances that you have started attracting from the dealers and guards have become more frequent. In a shadowed corner, a group of uniformed security gathers together in conversation. As you watch them, one looks at you and points in your direction. They begin to head your way...

name: Opening Hand
text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Each investigator who is at the same location as a ready [[Casino]] enemy raises their alarm level by 1. Forced - After an investigator defeats a [[Casino]] enemy: Raise that investigator's alarm level by 1.
real_text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Each investigator who is at the same location as a ready [[Casino]] enemy raises their alarm level by 1. Forced - After an investigator defeats a [[Casino]] enemy: Raise that investigator's alarm level by 1.
flavor: Défis de la Roulette is bustling on this busy night — the perfect cover for you and your crew. You hope that your long days of planning will pay off.
back_text: Spawn the set-aside Dimensional Shambler at the Roulette Wheel. Shuffle the encounter discard pile and the set-aside Plan in Shambles encounter set into the encounter deck. Raise each investigator's alarm level by 1.
back_flavor: A voice from the roulette tables cuts clearly through the din of the entire casino: "Red 19!" Someone nearby shouts in excitement. A few moments later, the same voice calls out once more: "Red 19 hits again!" You hear murmurings around you. Such an event is highly improbable. For a moment, you feel a small crackling in the air, but you shrug it off. Then, just when normalcy seems to have reasserted itself, the voice calls out once more in disbelief: "Red 19 a third time!" The crackling is unmistakable this time and begins to intensify until everything seems to blur for a moment. When your vision clears, a terrible creature beyond all imagining stands in the middle of the crowded casino, towering above the humans surrounding it. With a sinking feeling, you remember Isamara's warning that the relic's presence might invite disaster. If that wasn't bad enough, said disaster will fall on those who are not favored by the bearer of the Wellspring.

name: The Turn
text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Each investigator who is at the same location as a ready [[Casino]] enemy raises their alarm level by 1. Forced - After an investigator defeats a [[Casino]] enemy: Raise that investigator's alarm level by 1.
real_text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Each investigator who is at the same location as a ready [[Casino]] enemy raises their alarm level by 1. Forced - After an investigator defeats a [[Casino]] enemy: Raise that investigator's alarm level by 1.
flavor: The heist has become more complicated than you could have ever imagined. Terrifying monsters have appeared on the casino floor. The patrons, however, seem to be in a daze, while the staff continue to watch for suspicious activity. Can they not see the danger they are all in?
back_text:
Shuffle the 3 set-aside Fortune's Disfavor story cards and select 1 of them at random, resolving its text.
Raise each investigator's alarm level by 1.
back_flavor: Just when it seems like things couldn't get any worse, there is a strange transformation in the atmosphere of the casino, the calm before a storm. Then, like the last gasp before drowning, the storm of misfortune breaks...

name: All Bets Down
text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Each investigator who is at the same location as a ready [[Casino]] enemy raises their alarm level by 1. Forced - After an investigator defeats a [[Casino]] enemy: Raise that investigator's alarm level by 1.
real_text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Each investigator who is at the same location as a ready [[Casino]] enemy raises their alarm level by 1. Forced - After an investigator defeats a [[Casino]] enemy: Raise that investigator's alarm level by 1.
flavor: The cult is against you. Creatures from beyond time and space are against you. Now fortune itself is against you. No one said this would be easy.
back_text: Each investigator who did not resign is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma. (→R3)
back_flavor: You try desperately to escape, but your luck has run out at last. Several cultists wearing familiar coin medallions block your way out. Behind you, the horrifying creatures that were summoned by the Wellspring's power rampage through the casino. Chaos erupts around you. It is only then the crowds and the casino security seem to finally notice the horrible truth lurking within the casino. You try your best to fend off both the creatures and the cultists, and you barely escape with your life.

name: Casing the Joint
text: [reaction] After you trigger the [action] ability on a [[Game]] location: Remove 1 clue from The Wellspring of Fortune (2 clues instead if you gained resources from the [[Game]] location's ability). Objective - Accomplish as many tasks as you can and get out before you are noticed! If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
real_text: [reaction] After you trigger the [action] ability on a [[Game]] location: Remove 1 clue from The Wellspring of Fortune (2 clues instead if you gained resources from the [[Game]] location's ability). Objective - Accomplish as many tasks as you can and get out before you are noticed! If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
flavor: You must tread carefully, as arousing suspicion may ruin your plans before they have even begun.
back_text: Each investigator who was defeated raises their alarm level by 2. If the investigators, as a group, possess 10 [per_investigator] or more resources, remember that you “cleaned out the house.” (→R2)
back_flavor: With one last parting glance, you exit the casino. You're confident that none of the dealers or security suspected you for anything other than what you pretended to be: just another hopeful gambler. Regardless of any money that you made or lost tonight, your real winnings will be the information that you were able to gather. You hope that it will be enough to prepare you for the improbable scheme that you must now concoct and pull off.

name: The Take
text: [reaction] After you trigger the [action] ability on a [[Game]] location: Remove 1 clue from The Wellspring of Fortune (2 clues instead if you gained resources from the [[Game]] location's ability). Objective - If an investigator controls The Wellspring of Fortune, advance.
real_text: [reaction] After you trigger the [action] ability on a [[Game]] location: Remove 1 clue from The Wellspring of Fortune (2 clues instead if you gained resources from the [[Game]] location's ability). Objective - If an investigator controls The Wellspring of Fortune, advance.
flavor: The heist begins. You must open the vault door, locate the Wellspring, make it past the mystical defenses, and find a way to open the container that holds it.
back_text:
If Abarran Arrigorriagakoa is still in play...
Just as you are ready to celebrate victory, a voice calls from the door behind you. "You come into my casino and steal from me?" Abarran stands there, shaking with fury. "You'll ruin everything I built. But I won't let you!" Any front of professionalism has been dropped. The true danger of the man has been revealed.
Move Abarran Arrigorriagakoa (Abarran Unleashed) to Relic Room.
If Abarran Arrigorriagakoa is in the victory display...
A ragged voice gasps from behind you. "I won't let you take it!" Abarran is somehow still on his feet in the doorway behind you. Although he looks ready to collapse, his eyes burn with hatred. Before you can stop him, he slams his fist against some kind of mechanism on the wall before slumping to the ground. Large sections of the solid steel ceiling begin to fall from above...
Each investigator must test [agility] (3). Each investigator who fails takes 2 damage.

name: The Exit
text: Each [[Casino]] enemy loses aloof and patrol. Each [[Casino]] enemy gains hunter and "Prey - Investigator that controls The Wellspring of Fortune." Objective - If the investigator with The Wellspring of Fortune has resigned, advance. (Beware - any investigator who has not resigned will be left behind!)
real_text: Each [[Casino]] enemy loses aloof and patrol. Each [[Casino]] enemy gains hunter and "Prey - Investigator that controls The Wellspring of Fortune." Objective - If the investigator with The Wellspring of Fortune has resigned, advance. (Beware - any investigator who has not resigned will be left behind!)
flavor: Getting in was one thing, but now you must make it out with your prize. It feels as if the whole casino stands between you and the world outside.
back_text: Each investigator who has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma. (→R1)
back_flavor: There were times when you weren't sure whether you would make it out of the casino with your skin and soul intact, but here you stand. It almost feels like a dream, but you can still hear a commotion inside. It's time to leave this place behind and make yourself scarce.

name: Poker Table
text: [action] Spend 2 resources: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. You may mulligan once. If all 5 cards have a sequential rank, or if 3 or more of the cards have the same rank, gain 5 resources.
real_text: [action] Spend 2 resources: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. You may mulligan once. If all 5 cards have a sequential rank, or if 3 or more of the cards have the same rank, gain 5 resources.
flavor: Omaha 8-or-better, nothing's wild, sky's the limit.
back_flavor: The poker tables are constantly in demand, each game filled with players from around the continent and the world. Clattering fills the air as piles of chips are relentlessly pushed and stacked, each one a bet against destiny. The air is thick with smoke, sweat, and the tension of a good bluff.

name: Roulette Wheel
text: [action] Spend 1 resource: Name a color and a rank. Then, discard the top card of the encounter deck and check its game icon. If it matches the named color and rank, gain 5 resources.
real_text: [action] Spend 1 resource: Name a color and a rank. Then, discard the top card of the encounter deck and check its game icon. If it matches the named color and rank, gain 5 resources.
flavor: Red or black, what tickles your fancy?
back_flavor: Roulette seems to be a favorite of many patrons and of the establishment itself. The casino is named after this icon of Monte Carlo gambling, after all.

name: Baccarat Table
text: [action] Spend 2 resources: Name "player," "banker," or "tie." Discard the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. If the combined value of their ranks is higher than 18, the "player" wins. If the combined value is lower than 18, the "banker" wins. If the combined value is equal to 18, it is a "tie." If this result matches the result you named, gain 4 resources.

back_flavor: Baccarat has been popular among French nobility and aristocrats for over a century, perhaps longer. Even in this casino, this seems to remain true, with the most well-dressed and ostentatious sitting around the baccarat tables.

name: Slot Machines
text: [action] Spend 1 resource: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. If all 3 cards have the same suit or same rank, gain 3 resources.
real_text: [action] Spend 1 resource: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. If all 3 cards have the same suit or same rank, gain 3 resources.

back_flavor: Several rows of machines stand to one side, hooking unwary souls into an endless cycle of spend and pull, spend and pull, spend and pull. No skill or finesse needed here - just raw submission to the whims of fortune.

If the Anomalies in Spacetime story card is in play: Place 1 [per_investigator] horror on a River Docks location, as anomalies. Then, add 1 anomaly to each location with an anomaly.

back_flavor: Traveling through time may cause unintended consequences...

text: Forced - When a [[Scientist]] asset would be defeated: It is abducted instead (set it aside, out of play).
real_text: Forced - When a [[Scientist]] asset would be defeated: It is abducted instead (set it aside, out of play).

back_text: Each remaining investigator in all eras is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma. If the Edwin Bennet asset is in play in any era, proceed to (→R2). If the Edwin Bennet enemy is in play in any era, proceed to (→R3). Otherwise, proceed to (→R4).
back_flavor: No matter what you do, no matter where you go, packs of Hounds harry and pursue you. They emerge from angular space to snatch you up and drag you to their realm of hellish torment. You can go on no further. You have failed to fix the broken timeline.

name: Walking Through Time

[reaction] When you move to a location, if one or more [[Scientist]] assets are at your location: Move any number of them with you. Objective - Restore the timeline by completing the objective on each story card. If Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski are at non-Tindalos locations in all 3 eras, and each era has no story cards in play, advance.

Objective - Restore the timeline by completing the objective on each story card. If Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski are at non-Tindalos locations in all 3 eras, and each era has no story cards in play, advance.
flavor: Nervously, you step through a portal and enter the realm of angular time and infinite depths.
back_flavor: You breathe a sigh of relief as you watch Thomas and Mary receive their well-earned award. The timeline appears to have been stitched back together, and things are as they should be. They thank you profusely, forever grateful for your integral contributions to their legacy. You wonder with cautious hope whether Edwin's machinations are truly over. The forces of Tindalos may never be defanged. You can only remain vigilant and hope that your meddling has caused no further paradox.

name: A Noble Legacy (Past)
text: Setup: Place the Nikola Tesla asset at the [[Past]] River Docks. Flip this story card over.
real_text: Setup: Place the Nikola Tesla asset at the [[Past]] River Docks. Flip this story card over.
flavor:
Thomas and Mary met as promising undergraduate students attending Miskatonic University. It is paramount that these two gifted minds meet and form an everlasting friendship.
Famed inventor Nikola Tesla is touring America and has arrived in Arkham by sea. You know Thomas and Mary witnessed Tesla's electrifying demonstration and regarded it as highly inspirational in their pursuit of science.
In its devotion to the sciences, the Universtiy is looking to upgrade and expand its campus. High on the wish list is an observatory, but a lack of funding makes such an exorbitant facility unlikely. A sizable donation would surely get the momentum started on such a notable project.
back_text: [action] If you, Thomas Corrigan, and Mary Zielinski are all at the [[Past]] Miskatonic University: Announce "Thomas and Mary have met." [action] If Thomas Corrigan, Mary Zielinski, and Nikola Tesla are all at the same location, spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Announce "Thomas and Mary are inspired by Nikola Tesla." [fast] If you are at the [[Past]] Miskatonic University, spend 2 [per_investigator] resources: Announce "funding for an observatory has begun." Objective - If all 3 abilities on this story card have been triggered, add it to the victory display (Place a resource token over each ability when it is triggered).

name: Arkham Gazette

[fast] Remove 1 newspaper from this location: Place 1 [per_investigator] clues (from the token pool) on this location. Look at the top 5 cards of the encounter deck, add 1 to the victory display, and put the rest on the top and/or bottom of that deck in any order.
real_text: [action]: Test any skill (4). If you succeed, gain 1 clue (from the token pool). [fast] Remove 1 newspaper from this location: Place 1 [per_investigator] clues (from the token pool) on this location. Look at the top 5 cards of the encounter deck, add 1 to the victory display, and put the rest on the top and/or bottom of that deck in any order.
back_flavor: The <u>Arkham Gazette</u> goes all the way back to the Revolutionary era, when the newspaper was a single handsheet publicizing local notices and businesses. Industrialization led to the <u>Gazette's</u> first automated printing press, and the newspaper's influence quickly spread beyond Arkham.

back_flavor: Exquisitely crafted timepieces of all shapes, sizes, and styles adorn the walls of O'Malley's Watch Shop. Each clock is unique and displays a different time, causing the serence ringing of various bells and chimes every few minutes.

back_flavor: Whirling with activity at all hours, the River Docks along the banks of the Miskatonic are the heart of the Merchant District. Numerous goods and travelers from across the Eastern Seaboard pass through the harbor every day.

name: Miskatonic University
text: [action] [action] Remove 1 seed from this location: Announce "a tree seed has been planted." Gain 1 resource for each [[Scientist]] asset at this location.

flavor: The brilliant minds of Miskatonic's College of Sciences motivate one another to ever-ascending heights.
back_flavor: Founded in 1690, the prestigious Miskatonic University is one of New England's most notable institutions of higher learning. The university's lauded academic disciplines attract promising students from across the country and abroad.

name: A Noble Legacy (Present)
text: Setup: Place the Ezra Graves asset at the [[Present]] Arkham Advertiser. Flip this story card over.
real_text: Setup: Place the Ezra Graves asset at the [[Present]] Arkham Advertiser. Flip this story card over.
flavor:
When funding is reached and construction is completed, Miskatonic University's newest building, the Gerald Warren Astronomical Observatory, will sit high atop Crane Hill. The facility will feature state-of-the-art equipment, such as a high-powered telescope, that will be able to explore the depths of the universe. The new data it provides could be invaluable to the research of Thomas and Mary.
While brief, the fortuitous collaboration with a professor of the arcane, Ezra Graves, was vital in steering Thomas and Mary down the right path. You'll have to ensure this chance encounter occurs.
back_text: [action] If you are at the [[Present]] Miskatonic University and "funding for an observatory has begun:" Announce "the observatory is built." [action] If "the observatory is built," "Thomas and Mary are inspired by Nikola Tesla," and Thomas Corrigan, Mary Zielinski and Ezra Graves are at the [[Present]] Miskatonic University, spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group (4 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, instead if you are playing in Epic Multiplayer Mode): Announce "teleportation research has begun." [fast] If "Thomas and Mary have met" and Thomas Corrigan and Mary Zielinski are at Ye Olde Magick Shoppe, spend 1 [per_investigator] resources: Announce "Corrigan Industries has been founded" and put the set-aside Corrigan Industries location into play in the future era. back_flavor: Jenny Barnes has spent the majority of her young life in pursuit of creature comforts, fine dining, and the latest fashions. That all changed when she received a letter from her sister, Isabelle. In this letter, Isabelle confessed that mysterious forces were aligning against her and that she feared she may fall victim to some paranormal threat. It was the last letter Jenny received from her beloved sister. Jenny has since returned to the States to track down and investigate all occult occurrences she can find. Hardly a wilting flower, she has proven herself a crack shot as well as a fearless and clever investigator of the unknown. Until Isabelle's disappearance is explained, Jenny will never relent in her search.

back_flavor: Mateo Castile's life has not been easy since he became a priest. Recent decades in Mexico have been wracked with instability and conflict. Father Mateo struggled to balance his faith with the pragmatic concerns of preaching when the law told him he must not. But this is not what has assaulted Mateo's faith at its core. The nearby murders and kidnappings were not politically motivated, as he had suspected. A gruesome and horrid cult thrives at the heart of the brewing war. How, Mateo wonders, could a kind and loving God allow what he saw that night to exist?

back_flavor:
The tunnel collapses behind the mine cart to expose a cavern filled with glowing violet crystals. The cart crashes into a boulder to send you flying headlong into the dark. As more tremors rock the tunnel, you scramble to keep ahead of the cave-in, terrified of what might happen if you are trapped here. As you sprint past a rotten, slack-jawed corpse, you almost gag from the stench, then trip on a fallen rock and hit your head.
You wake up hours later, head pounding, and wonder in a daze until you catch the scent of fresh air and follow it out of the mine.

name: Eerie Silence
flavor: Your first steps into the old manor come with a fetid odor and an intense feeling of being watched. The air is too still, and for an abandoned house, there is an unsettling lack of dust on the furniture and floors. If nobody has lived here for years, then why does it feel like everything has moved recently?
back_text:
Shuffle each copy of the set-aside Out of the Walls and Pulled In treacheries into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
Find the unsealed [[Dormant]] location nearest to the most investigators. Flip that location to its enemy-location side.
Find the set-aside The Predatory House story card and resolve its text.
back_flavor:
At the sound of creaking wood, you spin to face the hall you came from. Everything looks as it was, and yet you cannot shake the feeling that things are subtly different. Letting out a held breath, you resume your investigation, only to find the furniture in your room settling into place, like children playing a game of musical chairs. A slimy tentacle retreats between a gap in the wood.
The rumors regarding Hemlock House were only half right. There is something living within its walls. But it is something far worse than you could have imagined.

back_flavor: The house groans and creaks, as though it is still settling. Movement stirs in the corner of your eye: the floor itself ripples like water as something moves beneath the creaking old boards.

back_flavor: Tumultuous rain pelts the roof of the house. The sky outside is swathed in dark clouds, illuminated only by brief flashes of light in the distance. Your skin crawls as the groans and creaks are muffled by the roar of thunder and the downpour crashing against the windows. Just then, bright light floods the room, and a resounding crack booms from the top floor of the house. The smell of burning wood drifts down into the halls. Lightning has struck the house!

Hopefully it won't resurface, but in the meantime, the legacy of the Hemlock family still stands. Maybe in time, they can find a way to exterminate the creature for good.

name: Into the Caves
text: Cards at [[Dark]] locations use (Night [night]) effects. Cards at all other locations use (Day [day]) effects.
real_text: Cards at [[Dark]] locations use (Night [night]) effects. Cards at all other locations use (Day [day]) effects.
flavor: Waves crash on the shoreline, threatening to wipe out a set of footprints that lead into the tidal caverns. You catch the faintest glimpse of a dim, blue glow deep within the tunnels.
back_text: Spawn one of the set-aside Crustacean Hybrid enemies at the [[Coastal]] location nearest to the most investigators, (In the Light) side faceup. Each investigator at a [[Dark]] location must discard 1 card at random from their hand. Place doom on agenda 2a equal to the current day number.
back_flavor: A whirring, chittering sound echoes off the tunnel walls. A large, crab-like creature emerges from a nearby tidal pool, antennae swaying in the air as if searching for you. The thing moves surprisingly fast on dozens of legs, and its carapace is covered in sharp barnacles and strings of kelp and rotten seaweed. Whatever it is, it emits the most awful, rotten stench you have ever smelled.

pack_name: Uczta w Dolinie Hemlock - Rozszerzenie kampanijne
name: Darkness Closes In
text: Cards at [[Dark]] locations use (Night [night]) effects. Cards at all other locations use (Day [day]) effects.
real_text: Cards at [[Dark]] locations use (Night [night]) effects. Cards at all other locations use (Day [day]) effects.
flavor: The cavern walls are alive with churning, shifting fungal growths. And they seem to be following you.
back_text: Each surviving investigator who has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
back_flavor:
You find yourself surrounded in the dark by dozens of shadowy forms, clacking and chittering. More unsettling still is the soft glowing moss that spreads across the slick walls and ceiling of the tidal cave. As the creatures and shifting moss press in, suffocatingly close, you lose your balance and fall into a thick carpet of moss. Up close, you see small buds and spiny growths in the moss that palpitate and turn toward you like a hundred tiny mouths.
As you feel your limbs go numb, a pair of hands pulls you from the moss. Helen Peters drags you bodily out of the cave, cursing under her breath.

name: The Missing Sibling
text: Forced - After the last clue is discovered from a [[Cave]] location: Put the top card of the Caverns deck into play adjacent to that location. Objective - Find Elizabeth Peters! If the investigators "found a torn dog leash" and "found a set of footprints," immediately advance.

flavor: Elizabeth Peters has gone missing in these coastal caves, chasing after the family dog. Helen is determined to get her back.
back_text:
Choose a [[Coastal]] location (with no investigators, if able). Put the set-aside Fungal Cave location into play adjacent to the chosen location.
Put the top card of the Caverns deck into play, adjacent to the Fungal Cave. Repeat this until the Fungal Cave is connected to four locations, or the Caverns deck is empty.
back_flavor:
"She's alive. Though I doubt Bruce is," Helen says, gripping the torn dog leash in one hand. You follow her as she tracks a set of footprints deeper into the darkness. As your eyes readjust to the low light, you notice the footprints glow with the leavings of the bioluminescent fungus covering the cavern floors.
"It's this way. Be ready for anything," Helen says. You steel yourself and keep step beside her. Ahead, an unsettling click and whir tell you that you are far from alone...

pack_name: Uczta w Dolinie Hemlock - Rozszerzenie kampanijne

text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues and choose an enemy at a connecting [[Dark]] location: Move that enemy to your location. Objective - When an investigator enters Fungal Cave, immediately advance.
real_text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues and choose an enemy at a connecting [[Dark]] location: Move that enemy to your location. Objective - When an investigator enters Fungal Cave, immediately advance.
flavor: Lizzie's glowing footprints lead to an unexplored chamber deep in the caverns. Through your exploration, you now know how to lure the ravenous creatures with glowing moss out of the darkness and into the light.
back_text: Spawn the set-aside Limulus Hybrid at the Fungal Cave. Remove Helen Peters from the game. If Theo Peters is under the control of any investigator, ([codex] Σ) (page 25).
back_flavor:
"Helen!" Elizabeth's shrill, desperate cry cuts through the silence. A young woman with a round face and torn clothes hobbles out of the darkness to embrace her sister. As the pair embrace, their reunion is cut short by a fearsome screech. A massive crustacean the size of a house advances, pincers raised threateningly. The thing's slick, shining form is illuminated in green and blue by the cavern moss, and it emits a smell like rotten shellfish.
"Can you walk?" Helen asks her sister. Lizzie shakes her head. As the massive creature comes closer, you tell the pair to run. Helen looks torn for a moment, then nods in thanks before carrying her sister away.

back_flavor: The towering abomination thrashes and squirms, its massive bulk shuddering in violent death throes. At long last, the monstrosity goes still. A filmy blue fluid leaks from its eyes and carapace, smelling like more awful, rotten shellfish. Covering your nose and mouth, you head back to Akwan.

The brilliance ascends into the night sky like a falling star in reverse, reducing everything around you to dust. Trees wither and desiccate, and fleeing wildlife are turned to bone and ash. Your body sublimates, rising into the blinding brilliance along with everything else on Hemlock Isle.
You have learned your place in infinity.

back_text: The investigators must decide (choose one): - Let Dr. Marquez carry out her plan (→R1) (page 66). - Do it ourselves (→R2) (page 67). (You may only choose this if an investigator controls Prismatic Shard story asset.)
back_flavor: You stand next to Dr. Marquez at the base of a mound of desiccated bodies. Above, the Abyss flickers in the still, cold air. A hazy humanoid shape reaches toward you as the brilliance flares again, blindingly bright. "It's no good. We need to disrupt it. Feed it something it can't 'digest,'" Dr. Marquez says soberly. She hands you her satchel filled with survey notes and samples. "I want you to have this." You ask why. "Someone needs to tell Dr. Armitage the story of this..." her eyes narrow, staring up at the flickering iridescence. "...this colour out of space."

flavor: You'll have to either talk sense into the frenzied residents... or knock it out of them.
back_flavor: "Get in the truck!" A resident waves a crowd of dazed locals onto the vehicle. The remaining survivors pile into trucks and weather-beaten bikes and drive down the winding southern road. As you pass the dilapidated harbor, a pillar of pure light shoots up from the village center followed by an oily, viscous cloud. The train of survivors have just taken refuge in the southern lighthouse when a shockwave of hot air tears across the island with a hurricane force.

name: Fate of the Vale (v.III)
text: [action] Spend X [per_investigator] clues: Place X resources on your location, as kindling (you may spend 5 resources or discard an [[Item]] asset you control to place 1 additional kindling). [action] If your location has kindling on it equal to or greater than its shroud value, remove all kindling from it: Draw 1 set-aside Fire! treachery. (Group limit once per location.) Objective - When the round ends, if there are 5 copies of Fire! in play, immediately advance.
real_text: [action] Spend X [per_investigator] clues: Place X resources on your location, as kindling (you may spend 5 resources or discard an [[Item]] asset you control to place 1 additional kindling). Objective - When the round ends, if there are 5 copies of Fire! in play, immediately advance.
flavor: Your only hope of stopping this thing is to burn this accursed island. All of it.
back_flavor:
Fireworks shoot up into the sky as Hemlock Vale is consumed in the blaze. The whizzing lights and loud crackles almost distract from the devastating inferno as it devours the landscape. Poms of red, yellow, and blue fireworks launch into the air to explode in the night sky.
You and Dr. Marquez join the few remaining survivors on a trek to the island's southern reach to take refuge in a crumbling lighthouse. As you watch the inferno from a smudged window, a thread of thin, gray light shoots up from the village center, then winks out. A small, phosphorescent light plummets back into the blaze like a fallen star.

pack_name: Uczta w Dolinie Hemlock - Rozszerzenie kampanijne
name: Fate of the Vale (v.IV)
text: [action] If at least 5 of the following are true (the investigators found gas, the investigators found Theo's truck, the road is clear, the survey notes were recovered, Bertie is fleeing, the samples were found): Resign. You flee the Vale. Objective - Escape with your lives! If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.

flavor: You must escape with your lives!
back_flavor:
With Dr. Marquez in tow, you gather the few survivors that remain and pile into Theo's sky blue truck. The locals shout directions as you drive south down a winding road to the southernmost point of the island. Shaking from the adrenaline, your small band of survivors takes refuge in the crumbling lighthouse.
Before you enter, you turn to see a sight you will never forget. A pillar of pure light shoots up from the Vale, drawing the oily viscous cloud in its wake. A shockwave tears across the island, and you fall to your knees, exhausted, as though years of your life were stolen from you in a single moment. You are transfixed by the dazzling light as it launches up through the stratosphere and into space.

[cultist]: -X. X to liczba atutów z cechą [[Gość]] w twojej lokalizacji (maksymalnie 5).

back_text:
TRUDNY / EKSPERCKI

name: Masked Revelers
text: Each [[Lantern Club]] enemy cannot be dealt damage. Doom cannot be removed from this agenda by card effects. Forced - When a single-sided [[Guest]] asset would leave play: It becomes spellbound instead (flip it facedown, lose control of it, and heal all damage and horror from it).
real_text: Each [[Lantern Club]] enemy cannot be dealt damage. Doom cannot be removed from this agenda by card effects. Forced - When a single-sided [[Guest]] asset would leave play: It becomes spellbound instead (flip it facedown, lose control of it, and heal all damage and horror from it).
flavor: Promising to be a night of intrigue and wonder, the gala is expected to be filled with secrets and whispers that are as much a part of the entertainment as the drinks and music.
back_text: Shuffle each set-aside [[Monster]] enemy, both copies of the Vicious Ambush treachery, and the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
back_flavor: A crash resounds from somewhere deeper in the manor, followed by a scream. Declan Pearce emerges to calm the crowd in the ballroom, but you can't help but notice the masked attendants have positioned themselves in front of each of the manor's many exits.

name: Unexpected Guests
text: Parley abilities on each [[Lantern Club]] enemy cannot be triggered. Doom cannot be removed from this agenda by card effects. Forced - When a single-sided [[Guest]] asset would leave play: It becomes spellbound instead (flip it facedown, lose control of it, and heal all damage and horror from it).
real_text: Parley abilities on each [[Lantern Club]] enemy cannot be triggered. Doom cannot be removed from this agenda by card effects. Forced - When a single-sided [[Guest]] asset would leave play: It becomes spellbound instead (flip it facedown, lose control of it, and heal all damage and horror from it).
flavor: Commotion stirs deeper within the manor as various guests ask the attendants to be let out. Other guests shuffle through the manor with dead eyes and blank stares.
back_text:
If The Bloodless Man (Silent Lurker) is in play:
You turn around to see the Bloodless Man striding toward you with murderous intent. Before you can react, the imposing figure staggers, then falls face first onto the red carpet.

Moments later, a sharp sound of ripping cloth breaks the silence. Glistening appendages erupt from the Bloodless Man's torn suit and limbs, blossoming into a grotesque amalgam of flesh and writhing tentacles. Your stomach churns as the creature's bone-white mask stares down at you, set in a maw of nightmarish limbs and gnashing fangs.
Flip The Bloodless Man (Silent Lurker) to his (Unleashed) side.
Otherwise:
The clamor around you seems to quiet for a moment.
Each investigator may heal 1 horror from an investigator or [[Guest]] asset at their location.

name: A Killer Party
text: Parley abilities on each [[Lantern Club]] enemy cannot be triggered. Doom cannot be removed from this agenda by card effects. Forced - When a single-sided [[Guest]] asset would leave play: It becomes spellbound instead (flip it facedown, lose control of it, and heal all damage and horror from it).
real_text: Parley abilities on each [[Lantern Club]] enemy cannot be triggered. Doom cannot be removed from this agenda by card effects. Forced - When a single-sided [[Guest]] asset would leave play: It becomes spellbound instead (flip it facedown, lose control of it, and heal all damage and horror from it).
flavor: The party descends into utter mayhem, with guests throwing themselves out of glass doors and windows to escape the otherworldly monstrosities.
back_text: Each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
back_flavor: A rank stench pervades the once-stately manor. As more and more nightmarish creatures overtake wounded or dazed guests, you dash out from a hiding place to make a beeline for the exit. A ravenous creature, the stuff of nightmares, catches wind of your scent and pursues you doggedly to the exit. You feel its claws on your throat as you throw yourself through the solid pane of glass, straight onto a gory pile of bodies covered in lightly falling snow.

name: Meet and Greet
text: [[Guest]] assets do not take up ally slots. [action] Choose a [[Guest]] asset and a skill icon on it at your location: Parley. Test that skill (3). If you succeed, take control of that asset. [action] If you control a [[Guest]] asset: Give control of it to another investigator at your location. Objective - If each undefeated investigator controls a [[Guest]] asset and the current agenda is 2a or 3a, they may spend the requisite amount of clues, as a group, to advance.
real_text: [[Guest]] assets do not take up ally slots. [action] Choose a [[Guest]] asset and a skill icon on it at your location: Parley. Test that skill (3). If you succeed, take control of that asset. [action] If you control a [[Guest]] asset: Give control of it to another investigator at your location. Objective - If each undefeated investigator controls a [[Guest]] asset and the current agenda is 2a or 3a, they may spend the requisite amount of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: You notice the Jewel is no longer in the ballroom. Maybe a guest saw someone move it?
back_text: Choose one of the set-aside [[Second Floor]] locations at random and put it into play directly above the Lobby. For the rest of the game, that location is connected to the Lobby, and vice versa. Put the other 2 set-aside locations into play in a row to the right of the previously placed [[Second Floor]] location. Put the set-aside rival story card into play next to the agenda, [[Rival]] side faceup, and follow its Setup text. Read Interlude: The Fabled Jewel (page 13).
back_flavor: You and your contact meet with several guests, who each confirm that the Jewel was taken by Declan Pearce from the display case in the Ballroom. Furthermore, strange sounds have begun to emanate from the second floor of the manor...

name: Finding the Jewel
text: [[Guest]] assets do not take up ally slots. [action] Choose a [[Guest]] asset and a skill icon on it at your location: Parley. Test that skill (3). If you succeed, take control of that asset. Objective - Complete the objective on your faction story card, and try to accomplish as many tasks as you can (see page 24 of the rulebook).
real_text: [[Guest]] assets do not take up ally slots. [action] Choose a [[Guest]] asset and a skill icon on it at your location: Parley. Test that skill (3). If you succeed, take control of that asset. Objective - Complete the objective on your faction story card, and try to accomplish as many tasks as you can (see page 24 of the rulebook).
flavor: You must help your contact and their associates, no matter the cost.
back_flavor: You take a deep breath as you stagger out into the cold night air. Snow falls thickly on the once-pristine lawn, now stained red with blood. The manor is dead silent behind you. The Jewel of Sarnath pulses with an unearthly light in your palm, and for a moment you feel a balmy breeze, the scent of another place both familiar and dreamlike. Was the gem worth all this devastation?

name: Hol
text: [fast] Jeśli trwa tajemnica 2a lub 3a, wydaj 1 [per_investigator] żetonów zasobów: ktoś dotarł nieźle po czasie. Odkryj wierzchnią kartę z talii Gości i umieść ją w grze w tej lokalizacji. (Limit grupowy raz na rundę).
real_text: [fast] If the current agenda is 2a or 3a, spend 1 [per_investigator] resources: Someone is fashionably late. Reveal the top card of the Guest deck and put it into play at this location. (Group limit once per round.)
flavor: Zimowy chłód przeszywa was do szpiku kości. Coś tu nie gra...
back_flavor: Drzwi wejściowe prowadzą do pomieszczenia pełnego dzieł sztuki, licznych gości i przykuwającym wzrok żyrandolem. Poczęstuj się drinkiem, to będzie długa noc.

name: Komnata Latarni
text:
[fast] Podczas twojej tury wymień nazwę karty: dobierz wierzchnią kartę z talii spotkań. Jeśli dobrana została wymieniona karta, anuluj jej efekty i ją odrzuć. Odkryj 1 żeton wskazówki w tej lokalizacji. (Limit raz na turę).
[action] Jeśli w tej lokalizacji nie ma żadnych żetonów wskazówek: wykonaj test [willpower] (4). Jeśli test zakończy się sukcesem, odwróć dowolną owładniętą kartę.
real_text:
[fast] During your turn, name a card: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. If it is the named card, cancel its effects and discard it. Discover 1 clue at this location. (Limit once per turn.)
[action] If this location has no clues: Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, flip over any spellbound card.
back_text: Jako dodatkowy koszt wejścia do tej lokalizacji, musisz otrzymać 1 punkt przerażenia.
back_flavor: Kładąc dłoń na gałce od drzwi tego cichego sanktuarium, czujesz mroźne ukłucie.

name: Galeria sztuki
text: [action]: W tym pełnym dzieł sztuki pokoju kryje się więcej, niż widać na pierwszy rzut oka. Umieść do 2 żetonów wskazówek (z puli żetonów) w tej lokalizacji. Zyskaj 2 żetony zasobów. (Limit grupowy raz na rundę).
real_text: [action]: There's more to be discovered in this room full of strange works of art. Place up to 2 clues (from the token pool) on this location. Gain 2 resources. (Group limit once per round.)
flavor: Prezentowane tu eksponaty to górna półka awangardy.
back_flavor: Okazałe pomieszczenia wypełnia muzyka i śmiech.

name: Sala balowa
text: [action]: Pertraktacje. Zachęcasz parę gości do wyjścia na parkiet. Wyczerp 2 atuty z cechą [[Gość]] w tej lokalizacji. Następnie wylecz po 1 punkcie przerażenia z każdego z nich.
real_text: [action]: Parley. You persuade two of the guests to have a dance. Exhaust 2 [[Guest]] assets at this location. Then, heal 1 horror from each of them.
flavor: Grają jeden z utworów mniej znanego kompozytora, niejakiego E. Zanna.
back_flavor: Okazałe pomieszczenia wypełnia muzyka i śmiech.

name: Bar
text: [fast] Wydaj 1 żeton zasobu: kupujesz drinka! Wylecz 1 obrażenie lub 1 punkt przerażenia z atutu z cechą [[Gość]] lub badacza w tej lokalizacji. (Limit grupowy raz na rundę).
real_text: [fast] Spend 1 resource: Buy a drink! Heal 1 damage or 1 horror from an investigator or [[Guest]] asset at this location. (Group limit once per round.)
flavor: „Nieźle pali w gardzioł!”
back_flavor: Okazałe pomieszczenia wypełnia muzyka i śmiech.

name: Sypialnia
text: [action] Wybierz wroga w dowolnej lokalizacji z cechą [[Pierwsze piętro]]: Walka. Do tego ataku możesz użyć twojej [agility] zamiast twojej [combat]. Jeśli test zakończy się sukcesem, możesz wydać 1 żeton wskazówki, aby ten atak zadał +2 obrażenia. (Limit raz na turę).
real_text: [action] Choose an enemy at any [[Second Floor]] location: Fight. You may use [agility] instead of [combat] for this attack. If you succeed, you may spend 1 clue for this attack to deal +2 damage. (Limit once per turn.)
back_flavor: Na piętrze jest wyjątkowo cicho.

name: Biblioteka
text:
Otrzymujesz +1 do wartości umiejętności podczas pertraktacji w tej lokalizacji.
[fast] Jeśli Klejnot Sarnathu znajduje się w tej lokalizacji: wykonaj test [intellect] (3). Jeśli test zakończy się sukcesem, umieść 1 obrażenie na Klejnocie Sarnathu lub usuń z niego 1 żeton. (Limit grupowy raz na grę.)
real_text:
You get +1 skill value while parleying at this location.
[fast] If the Jewel of Sarnath is at this location: Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, either place 1 damage on the Jewel of Sarnath or remove 1 token from it. (Group limit once per game.)
back_flavor: Na piętrze jest wyjątkowo cicho.

name: Salon
text:
Ta lokalizacja dostaje -1 do wartości zasłony za każdy atut z cechą [[Gość]], który się w niej znajduje (do minimalnie 1 wartości zasłony).
[fast] Jeśli kontrolujesz Klejnot Sarnathu: wyczerp wroga w dowolnej lokalizacji. (Limit grupowy raz na grę.)
real_text:
This location gets -1 shroud for each [[Guest]] asset at it (to a minimum of 1 shroud).
[fast] If you control the Jewel of Sarnath: Exhaust an enemy at any location. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: Księżycowa bestia w butelce? Dziwne...
back_flavor: Na piętrze jest wyjątkowo cicho.

name: Fundacja [guardian]
text: Wymuszony – Kiedy Człowiek bez Krwi (Uwolniony) zostanie pokonany: jeśli Klejnot Sarnathu jest do niego dołączony, dołącz Klejnot do jego lokalizacji. [action] Jeśli Klejnot Sarnathu znajduje się w twojej lokalizacji i Człowiek bez Krwi nie znajduje się w grze: przejmij kontrolę nad Klejnotem Sarnathu i umieść na nim 1 obrażenie. Cel – Na koniec rundy, jeśli badacze kontrolują Klejnot Sarnathu, mogą wydać, jako grupa, 2 [per_investigator] żetonów wskazówek, aby spowodować postęp talii aktów. Końcowa punktacja: 4 punkty, jeżeli w grze nie ma żadnego wroga innego niż osłabienie (zamiast tego 2 punkty, jeżeli w grze jest dokładnie 1 wróg inny niż osłabienie).
real_text: Forced - When The Bloodless Man (Unleashed) is defeated: If the Jewel of Sarnath is attached to him, attach it to his location. [action] If the Jewel of Sarnath is at your location and The Bloodless Man is not in play: Take control of the Jewel of Sarnath and place 1 damage on it. Objective - At the end of the round, if the investigators control the Jewel of Sarnath, they may spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to advance the act. End of game scoring: 4 points if no non-weakness enemies are in play (2 points instead if exactly one non-weakness enemy is in play).
flavor: „Władze” oczekują, że siłą zdobędziecie dla nich Klejnot. Powodzenia w odebraniu go Człowiekowi bez Krwi.

linked_card.flavor: Fundacji nie w smak jest wasze zainteresowanie Klejnotem. Jeśli będziecie twardzi, być może odpuszczą.

name: Valeriya Antonova
text: Dostajesz +1 [combat]. [action] Wyczerp Valeriye Antonove: przygotuj inny atut z cechą [[Gość]] w twojej lokalizacji. Dostajesz +1 do wartości umiejętności do twojego kolejnego testu umiejętności w tej rundzie, za każdy atut z cechą [[Gość]] w twojej lokalizacji. Wymuszony - Kiedy Valeriya Antonova opuszcza grę: usuń ją z gry.
real_text: You get +1 [combat]. [action] Exhaust Valeriya Antonova: Ready another [[Guest]] asset at your location. You get +1 to your next skill test this round for each [[Guest]] asset at your location. Forced - When Valeriya Antonova leaves play: Remove her from the game.

linked_card.name: Valeriya Antonova
linked_card.text:
Powściągliwy. Łowca.

Valeriya Antonova nie może otrzymać obrażeń.

Każdy badacz w tej lokacji otrzymuje -1 do wartości umiejętności, jeśli kontroluje wyczerpany atut z cechą Gość.

Wymuszony – Koniec rundy: wyczerp każdy atut z cechą Gość w tej lokalizacji.
linked_card.real_text: Aloof. Hunter. Valeriya Antonova cannot be damaged. Each investigator at this location gets -1 to each of their skills if they control an exhausted [[Guest]] asset. Forced - When the round ends: Exhaust each [[Guest]] asset at this location.

name: Valeriya Antonova

name: Archibald Hudson
text:
[fast] Podczas twojej tury, wyczerp Archibalda Hudsona: przeszukaj 9 wierzchnich kart z talii spotkań w poszukiwa-niu dowolnego wroga, dobierz go i potasuj talię spotkań. Następnie wyczerp danego wroga i zyskaj 3 żetony zasobów.
[action] Wydaj 1 żeton zasobu: porusz 1 obrażenie z atutu w twojej lokalizacji na nie-[[Elitarnego]] wroga w twojej lokalizacji.
real_text:
[fast] During your turn, exhaust Archibald Hudson: Search the top 9 cards of the encounter deck for an enemy, draw it, and shuffle the encounter deck. Then, exhaust that enemy and gain 3 resources.
[action] Spend 1 resource: Move 1 damage from an asset at your location to a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location.

name: Agent specjalny Callahan
text: [action]: Walka. Obniż trudność tego testu o 1. [reaction] Po tym, jak aktywujesz zdolność [action] na atucie z cechą [[Sprzymierzeniec]] lub [[Broń]], wyczerp Agenta specjalnego Callahana: zadaj 1 obrażenie wrogowi w twojej lokalizacji.
real_text: [action]: Fight. Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1. [reaction] After you trigger an [action] ability on an [[Ally]] or [[Weapon]] asset, exhaust Special Agent Callahan: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
flavor: „Przywitaj się z moim gnatem, Tommym!”

name: Horacio Martinez
text: Kiedy kontrolujesz Horacio Martineza, można mu przypisywać obrażenia zadawane innym badaczom w twojej lokalizacji. [reaction] Po tym, jak nie-[[Elitarny]] wróg cię zaatakuje, wyczerp Horacio Martineza: wyczerp danego wroga i w tej rundzie nie może się on przygotować (nie uwalniaj się ze zwarcia z nim).
real_text: While you control Horacio Martinez, he may be assigned damage dealt to other investigators at your location. [reaction] After a non-[[Elite]] enemy attacks you, exhaust Horacio Martinez: Exhaust that enemy and it cannot ready this round (do not disengage from it).

name: Rookie Cop
text: Surge. Aloof. Hunter. Forced - After an investigator at this location attacks another enemy: Deal 1 damage to that investigator.
real_text: Surge. Aloof. Hunter. Forced - After an investigator at this location attacks another enemy: Deal 1 damage to that investigator.

name: Uniwersytet Miskatonic [seeker]
text: Declan Pearce nie może otrzymywać obrażeń i nie może opuścić gry, dopóki jest do niego dołączony Klejnot Sarnathu. [action] Jeśli Declan Pearce znajduje się w twojej lokalizacji: Pertraktacje. Umieść do 2 twoich żetonów wskazówek na Declanie Pearce. Następnie, jeśli znajduje się na nim 3 [per_investigator] lub więcej żetonów wskazówek, przejmij kontrolę nad Klejnotem Sarnathu i dodaj Declana Pearce'a do puli zwycięstwa. Cel - Na koniec rundy, jeśli badacze kontrolują Klejnot Sarnathu, mogą spowodować postęp talii aktów. Końcowa punktacja: 1 punkt za łącznie 2 [per_investigator] kart na ręku wszystkich badaczy (maksymalnie 4 punkty).
real_text: Declan Pearce cannot be damaged or leave play while the Jewel of Sarnath is attached to him. [action] If Declan Pearce is at your location: Parley. Place up to 2 of your clues on Declan Pearce. Then, if 3 [per_investigator] or more clues are on him, take control of the Jewel of Sarnath and add Declan Pearce to the victory display. Objective - At the end of the round, if the investigators control the Jewel of Sarnath, they may advance the act. End of game scoring: 1 point per 2 [per_investigator] total cards in hand among all investigators (to a maximum of 4 points).
flavor: Pomagacie dziekanowi Caldwellowi „zdobyć” Klejnot, ale najpierw musicie przekonać Declana Pearce'a, aby rozstał się z przedmiotem.

linked_card.name: Uniwersytet Miskatonic [seeker]
linked_card.text:
Przygotowanie: Wtasuj odłożoną na bok kartę podstępu Dezorientacja do talii spotkań. Umieść odłożoną na bok kartę Caldwell Philips w grze, w lokalizacji głównego badacza, stroną wroga do góry.

Jeśli Caldwell Philips znajduje się w twojej lokalizacji: Pertraktacje. Wykonaj test (3). Jeśli test zakończy się sukcesem, umieść 1 z twoich żetonów wskazówek na tej karcie fabuły.

Wymuszony - Kiedy na tej karcie fabuły znajduje się 1 + 1 żetonów wskazówek: dodaj ją oraz Caldwella Philipsa do puli zwycięstwa. Przeszukaj talię spotkań i stos odrzuconych kart spotkań w poszukiwaniu Dezorientacji i usuń ją z gry. Potasuj talię spotkań.

back_flavor: An ear-splitting roar resounds through the bog, followed by several ripples that roll through the floating landscape. You feel a low tremble below you, and dive to safety just before a horrible monstrosity erupts from below. Rows of thin, needle-sharp teeth gnash at the air where you just were, and ghastly stalks on eyes turn to regard you with hunger.

flavor: The bog rocks with towering waves!
back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
back_flavor: As your sidestep to avoid a grasping tendril, two more wrap around your legs and neck. The noisome monstrosity emerges below you, slick with ichor, and opens its wide-angled mouth. You thrash wildly, and tear at the mossy tissue gathered around the tendrils holding you. A sudden movement of a silvery blossom turns the creature's attention away from you, and it drops you to follow its new prey. You spring back to the shoreline and collapse in a dead faint at the edge of the road.

back_flavor: You come to a round still pond on the northeastern shore of the bog. Atop a mound of wildflowers is a silvery alkaloid blossom very much like the sample that drew Dr. Marquez to Hemlock Isle. When you approach, the blossom swells to release a cloud of spores, then closes. The scent of the spores is pleasant, almost like cloves, but grows bitter the longer it lingers. Suddenly the mound of flowers moves. A large reptilian head rises out of the water and looks at you with intelligent eyes before swiftly swimming away.

You corner the reptilian creature in a shining pool, where it sinks into the mud, clearly exhausted. As it starts munching on a tangle of flowers, you take several sketches and notes of the thing's sprouting shell. The alkaloid blossom on its back seems to pulse. Producing a pair of shears, you prepare to take a sample.
If it is Day 1, read the following. Otherwise, (→R1).
"Stop!" Dr. Marquez shouts. "That flower is parasitic. It is now part of the creature's anatomy. There's no telling how deeply it's embedded." She points to the flower's thick translucent stem: vicious white fluid pumps through it like an artery. "If the flower dies, its host dies too."

name: George Barnaby
text:
Maksymalna liczba kart na twojej ręce jest równa liczbie zakrytych kart pod Georgem Barnabym. (Limit 5 kart).
Możesz przeznaczać zakryte karty pod Georgem Barnabym do testów umiejętności tak, jakby znajdowały się na twojej ręce.
[reaction] Po tym, jak odrzucisz kartę z twojej ręki: umieść ją zakrytą pod Georgem Barnabym, następnie dobierz 1 kartę. (Limit raz na fazę).
Efekt [elder_sign]: +1. Dobierz 1 kartę.
real_text:
Your max hand size is equal to the number of facedown cards beneath George Barnaby. (Limit 5 cards.)
You may commit facedown cards beneath George Barnaby to skill tests as if they were in your hand.
[reaction] After you discard a card from your hand: Place it facedown beneath George Barnaby, then draw 1 card. (Limit once per phase.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Draw 1 card.
back_text: Rozmiar talii: 35. Opcje tworzenia talii: karty Ocalałego ([survivor]) o poziomie 0-5, karty neutralne o poziomie 0-5, do 10 innych kart Poszukiwacza ([seeker]) i/lub Łotra ([rogue]) o poziomie 0. Wymogi tworzenia talii (nie wliczane do wielkości talii): 3 kopie Ponurej determinacji, Bezwolny dryf, 1 losowe podstawowe osłabienie. Dodatkowe przygotowanie: Po dobraniu początkowej ręki, możesz umieścić dowolną liczbę kart na ręce zakrytych pod Georgem Barnabym.
back_flavor: Po miesięcznej odsiadce w wieku 19 lat, George Barnaby poświęcił się bez reszty pragnieniu zostania prawnikiem. Odniósł ogromny sukces i zysał poważanie, a ponieważ zbliżał się do emerytury, to zaczął planować rejs dookoła świata wraz ze swą małżonką, Marią. Jednak tego samego wieczoru, w czasie kolacji z okazji przejścia na emeryturę, na dom napadli kultyści, mordując jego żonę. Zatem teraz, mając do dyspozycji więcej gotówki, niż zdołałby wydać, i rozliczne kontakty, George tropił kultystów aż do Arkham i postawił sobie za punkt honoru osądzenie ich za dokonane zbrodnie.

name: Ponura determinacja
text:
Tylko talia George'a Barnaby'ego.
Po tym, jak rozpatrzony zostanie ten test umiejętności, możesz zamienić miejscami dowolną liczbę kart pod Georgem Barnabym z taką samą liczbą kart, niebędących osłabieniami, na twojej ręce.
real_text:
George Barnaby deck only.
After this skill test resolves, you may swap any number of cards beneath George Barnaby with the same number of non-weakness cards in your hand.

name: Bezwolny dryf
text: Odkrycie - Jeśli pod Georgem Barnabym nie ma żadnej karty, wtasuj Bezwolny dryf do twojej talii. W przeciwnym razie, odrzuć każdą kartę pod Georgem Barnabym.

flavor: You’ve heard from some of the civilians fleeing to the perimeter of the quarantine zone that the military is sending in armor to secure Blackwater. You’re not sure a bigger gun is the answer, but it might help deter the creatures that have been wreaking havoc across the town. If you can clear the path and prevent it from getting devoured like the rest of the vehicles they’ve sent in, maybe it can make a real difference.
back_text:
Read only if "the escort failed:" Remove Mi-Go Destroyer, Armored Car, and this card from the game. Each investigator takes 1 damage. Lose 1 countermeasure.
Read only if "the car reached its target:"
It’s chilling what a machine of war can do when it’s fully unleashed, but in this case, you’re relieved at the thundering of its gun and the crunch of its tires on alien ground. With this area secure, the military can focus its efforts on the anomaly itself. Although they don’t thank you for your efforts directly, the detachment of agents following you around tells you they view you as an asset.
Put the set-aside G-Men story asset into play under any investigator’s control. Remove Armored Car from the game. Add Mi-Go Destroyer and this card to the victory display. Deal 5 damage to Subject 8L-08.

text: Revelation - Spawn the set-aside Mi-Go Scientist enemy at the location farthest from the Fungus Mound. Attach the set-aside Brain Case asset to Mi-Go Scientist. Put this card into play next to the act deck. Forced - If Brain Case is at Research Site and under an investigator’s control: Remember that "the brain was recovered." Flip this card over. Put this card into play next to the act deck. Forced - If Brain Case is at Research Site and under an investigator’s control: Remember that "the brain was recovered." Flip this card over. Forced - If Brain Case is at Fungus Mound and attached to Mi-Go Scientist: Remember that "the brain was taken." Flip this card over.
flavor: You thought you’d seen everything, but when you spot one of the creatures flying overhead with a human brain in its grasp, you realize you’re sorely mistaken. Even more surprising, it seemed to be cradling the brain safely inside a glass cylinder, as if it were a scientific sample. Are these monsters collecting human brains? The irony isn’t lost on you - the creatures are likely doing the same kind of research as the scientists at the research site - but even still, you have to find this creature and stop this sick experiment!
back_text:
Read only if "the brain was taken:" Remove Mi-Go Scientist, Brain Case, and this card from the game. The investigators, as a group, return 3 of their clues to the token pool.
Read only if "the brain was recovered:"
The scientists listen to your story and examine the cylinder. To your surprise, you hear a distorted voice from what must be a strange speaker stemming from the jar. The brain vibrates within. "Oh, thank the heavens. I can hear you. Where am I?" it asks. You explain what has transpired, and ask why the creatures were after it. "I know something they needed. Here, I can teach you - do you have a pen?"
Put the set-aside Corrosive Cloud story asset into play under any investigator’s control. Remove Brain Case from the game. Add Mi-Go Scientist and this card to the victory display. Any investigator discovers 1 clue each from up to 2 locations. Gain 1 countermeasure.

name: Marion Tavares
text:
Masz o 1 strefę ręki mniej.
[reaction] Po tym, jak w twojej turze zagrasz kartę wydarzenia: dobierz 1 kartę. Następnie możesz zagrać kartę innego wydarzenia (limit raz na rundę).
Efekt [elder_sign]: +1. Przeszukaj 3 wierzchnie karty z twojej talii w poszukiwaniu karty wydarzenia i dobierz ją. Potasuj swoją talię.
real_text:
You have 1 fewer hand slots.
[reaction] After you play an event during your turn: Draw 1 card. Then, you may play a different event. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Search the top 3 cards of your deck for an event and draw it. Shuffle your deck.
flavor: „Ludzie liczą, że zrobię swoją robotę. Żadne dziwactwa w wodzie tego nie zmienią”.
back_text: Rozmiar talii: 30. Wybór cechy: Podczas tworzenia talii, wybierz jedną z następujących: [[Los]], [[Gambit]], lub [[Improwizowany]]. Opcje tworzenia talii: karty Strażnika ([guardian]) o poziomie 0-5, karty neutralne o poziomie 0-5, karty wydarzeń z twoją wybraną [[cechą]] o poziomie 0-2, do 5 innych kart Ocalałego ([survivor]) o poziomie 0. Wymogi tworzenia talii (nie wliczane do wielkości talii): 2 kopie Zdeterminowana, „Sama to zrobię”, 1 losowe podstawowe osłabienie.
back_flavor: Po śmierci ojca Marion przeniosła się do Arkham z Zatoki Narragansett. Wraz ze swoją przyjaciółką, Annalise Taylor, zakupiła łódź i zadomowiła się pośród lokalnej społeczności rybaków. Pewnej burzowej nocy na morzu, Annalise została ściągnięta z pokładu przez jakąś dziwną, przypominającą rybę istotę. Marion natychmiast rzuciła się do wody i wydarła Annalise z paszczy stwora, co jednak przypłaciła utratą prawej ręki. Od tamtej pory bacznie przygląda się niespokojnym wodom Atlantyku w poszukiwaniu dziwnych istot w głębinach.

text:
[reaction] Po tym, jak wymkniesz się wrogowi z sukcesem o 2 lub więcej: odkryj 1 żeton wskazówki w twojej lokalizacji. (Limit raz na rundę).
Efekt [elder_sign]: +1 za każdego wroga w twojej lokalizacji.
real_text:
[reaction] After you successfully evade an enemy by 2 or more: Discover 1 clue at your location. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each enemy at your location.
flavor: „Cieszę się, że moje sny pozostały tylko w mojej głowie”.
back_text: Rozmiar talii: 30. Opcje tworzenia talii: karty Poszukiwacza ([seeker]) o poziomie 0-5, karty Łotra ([rogue]) o poziomie 0-2, karty neutralne o poziomie 0-5. Wymogi tworzenia talii (nie wliczane do wielkości talii): Księga wersów, Sny o potopie, 1 losowe podstawowe osłabienie.
back_flavor: Lucius, południowiec wychowany w Nowym Jorku, zyskał sławę wśród intelektualistów, artystów i muzyków w Harlemie za sprawą swojej onirycznej poezji. Amatorzy jego dzieł nie wiedzą jednak, że opisywane przez niego zatopione miasto nie powstało z inspiracji Nowym Jorkiem, lecz koszmarami jego zaginionego partnera, Rudiego. Przed swoim zniknięciem, Rudi opowiadał o koterii śniących w Arkham, którzy dzielili z nim te same wizje. Obecnie Lucius przyjął tymczasową posadę wykładowcy na Uniwersytecie Miskatonic, gdzie w wolnych chwilach szuka wskazówek, by odnaleźć zaginionego ukochanego, a być może i klucz do zrozumienia własnych koszmarów...

text:

back_flavor: Mając dyplom tak z matematyki, jak i psychologii, Agatha Crane zawsze opierała się o twarde dowody i metodę naukową. W młodości nie przywiązywała wagi do opowieści o duchach, jednak różne dowody przekonały ją, że pełne magii i potworów opowieści o Arkham nie są tylko czczymi bajaniami. A skoro te istoty są prawdziwe, to muszą podlegać określonym prawom. Jak tłumaczy każdemu, kto jak jej mąż Wilbur chce jej wysłuchać, ta nowa nauka nosi nazwę „parapsychologii”. Opierając się w pełni na metodzie naukowej, Agatha próbuje połączyć racjonalizm z mistycyzmem, i okultyzm z nauką.
